title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

By working as a Cleaning Supervisor at duuo, you will be working with the Cleaning department - a team of around 120 dedicated staff members that are serving 150+ customers in central Copenhagen and ensure that the quality of cleaning at our customers meets duuo's standards at all times.

The work is exclusively evenings during the week, and weekends and you will be expected to work both Saturday and Sunday.

The supervisor role is primarily responsible for active quality assurance on site. Other duties will include:

  • Specialist Cleaning

  • Training and mentoring

  • Replacement cleaning in case of illness and other issues

To qualify of this role, we would like to hear from candidates that have the following:

  • 5 years cleaning experience in Denmark

  • Full and Valid Driving License

  • Fluent English

To excel in this role, you will need to following attributes:

  • Attention to detail

  • Good people & communication skills

  • Some knowledge of Danish

  • Good problem solving and ability to work independently.

The location and nature of the work will change daily, we need someone that is adaptable and flexible and able to think on their feet and react to lots of unknown situations. Alongside this you need good humour and patience as you will be working with different people and different locations.

If you see yourself in this role, we would love to hear from you.

title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Postdoc in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Mathematics

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

  • Familiarity with explainable AI (xAI) methods for interpreting machine learning and deep learning models.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Experience in applying deep learning to biological problems.

  • Basic understanding of human disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

title: Qualified Carpenter with Glazing Experience - Construction - Lolland, Denmark
description:
Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

  • You are a qualified carpenter

  • You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

  • You have a valid driving licence

  • You can communicate in English

  • Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

  • A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

  • Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

  • Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

  • Pension scheme

  • Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

  • Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

title: Service Manager – Cleaning & Property Services
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Service Manager to take responsibility for the daily operation and coordination of our cleaning and property service activities.

As Service Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring high service standards across our customer sites. You will be responsible for coordinating employees, planning daily operations, maintaining quality standards and ensuring professional communication with our customers.

The position combines leadership, operational planning and customer service, and we are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions in a busy and dynamic working environment.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Daily management and coordination of service employees

  • Planning and allocation of cleaning and property maintenance tasks

  • Ensuring that agreed service levels and quality standards are maintained

  • Conducting regular quality inspections at customer sites

  • Managing daily operational changes, including sickness, absence and replacement staff

  • Recruitment, onboarding and introduction of new employees

  • Preparing and maintaining work schedules

  • Maintaining regular communication with customers and following up on their requirements

  • Handling operational issues and ensuring that challenges are resolved quickly and professionally

  • Coordinating cleaning supplies, equipment and machinery

  • Planning and coordinating property maintenance services

  • Coordinating seasonal outdoor maintenance, including lawn mowing, hedge trimming and general upkeep of outdoor areas

  • Supporting employees and ensuring clear instructions and expectations

  • Reporting and following up on daily operations with management

Your Profile

We are looking for a responsible and service-minded person who enjoys working with both people and operations.

Ideally, you:

  • Have previous experience within cleaning, facility services, property services or a similar service industry

  • Have experience managing or coordinating employees

  • Have strong organisational and planning skills

  • Are able to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities

  • Have a professional and customer-focused approach

  • Are solution-oriented and able to respond quickly when operational challenges arise

  • Are comfortable working in an environment where priorities may change during the day

  • Have basic IT skills and are comfortable using digital planning and communication tools

  • Hold a valid Category B driving licence

Previous experience with both commercial cleaning and property/outdoor maintenance is an advantage.

What We Offer

We offer an independent and responsible position in a growing service company where you will have a direct influence on daily operations and customer satisfaction.

You will be joining a company with short decision-making processes and a practical approach to solving challenges.

We offer:

  • A position with a high degree of responsibility and independence

  • A varied working day with both office and on-site responsibilities

  • Close cooperation with management, customers and employees

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

  • A dynamic working environment where no two days are exactly the same

title: Socialfaglig medarbejder / nattevagt/ vikar
description:
Socialfaglig medarbejder og fast tilkaldevikar søges til Toftehuset ApS

Der er tale om en fast stilling som socialfaglig medarbejder på 35 timer ugentligt og stillingen som fast vikaransættelse.
Angiv venligst i din ansøgning, hvilken stilling du er interesseret i.

Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Om Toftehuset

Toftehuset ApS har gennem 18 år skabt trygge rammer for mennesker med forskellige problematikker som misbrug, hjemløshed og forskellige psykosociale barrierer. Vi holder til i Hviding tæt på Ribe og har plads til ni beboere fordelt på vores matrikel, der omfatter både lejligheder, en hytte og en udslusningsbolig.

Vores beboere er voksne over 18 år, der er visiteret efter §§ 101, 107 og 108 samt hjemløse, der har ophold jf. §110. Derudover tilbyder vi socialpædagogisk støtte efter §85 samt afsoning efter §78.

Vi søger en engageret socialfaglig medarbejder

Vil du gøre en forskel for mennesker, der har brug for støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse?

Vi søger en engageret socialfaglig medarbejder til vores team. Arbejdstiden vil være 30 timer ugentligt, og der vil forekomme aften- og weekendvagter.

Som socialfaglig medarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af beboernes udvikling og hverdag. En central del af arbejdet er at støtte den enkelte beboer i at arbejde hen imod egne mål og delmål og i takt med deres forudsætninger udvikle færdigheder, struktur og selvstændighed.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med ADL, sociale kompetencer, økonomi, bolig, kontakt til offentlige myndigheder samt støtte til at skabe struktur og sammenhæng i hverdagen. Du vil også deltage i husets daglige aktiviteter og ledsagelse.

En væsentlig del af arbejdet er desuden den socialfaglige dokumentation. Du skal kunne observere, beskrive og dokumentere beboernes udvikling, progression og udfordringer samt være med til løbende at følge op på de mål og delmål, der arbejdes med. Dokumentationen er en vigtig del af vores faglige arbejde og skal være med til at sikre, at indsatsen tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov og udvikling.

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Du har en relevant socialfaglig uddannelse, f.eks. socialpædagog eller lign. uddannelse.

  • Du har interesse for arbejdet med mennesker i udsatte positioner og gerne erfaring fra socialområdet.

  • Du kan arbejde målrettet med beboernes udvikling og støtte dem i at nå deres individuelle mål og delmål.

  • Du kan dokumentere systematisk og fagligt og kan omsætte observationer til relevant dokumentation.

  • Du har forståelse for, at relation, struktur og tydelige rammer er væsentlige elementer i det socialfaglige arbejde.

  • Du har kørekort B.

  • Du er fleksibel og kan arbejde systematisk efter gældende retningslinjer.

  • Du er stabil, engageret og god til at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer.

  • Du kan fremvise straffeattest.

Dine ansvarsområder

  • Støtte og vejledning af beboerne i dagligdagens gøremål og udvikling af deres selvstændighed.

  • Arbejde målrettet med beboernes individuelle mål og delmål.

  • Observere og følge op på beboernes trivsel, udvikling og progression.

  • Udarbejde og ajourføre socialfaglig dokumentation.

  • Bidrage til statusbeskrivelser og evaluering af den socialfaglige indsats.

  • Deltage i husets daglige aktiviteter og ledsagelse.

  • Støtte beboerne i kontakten til offentlige myndigheder, sundhedsvæsen, familie og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere.

  • Indgå aktivt i det tværfaglige samarbejde omkring den enkelte beboer.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en konkret forskel for mennesker i udsatte positioner.

title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

title: Maler søges til TB Enterprise ApS
description:
TB Enterprise ApS søger en dygtig og engageret maler til vores team.

Om jobbet

Som maler hos TB Enterprise ApS vil du udføre forskellige typer malerarbejde på byggepladser og hos kunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Indvendigt og udvendigt malerarbejde

  • Maling af vægge, lofter, træværk og andre overflader

  • Opsætning og behandling af forskellige typer overflader

  • Klargøring af materialer og arbejdsområder

  • Reparation og finish af eksisterende malerarbejde

  • Sikring af, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med de aftalte kvalitetskrav

  • Oprydning og vedligeholdelse af arbejdsområdet

Vi forventer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med professionelt malerarbejde

  • Har gode håndværksmæssige færdigheder og sans for detaljer

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Kan samarbejde med kolleger og andre faggrupper

  • Er mødestabil og pålidelig

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og arbejdsmiljø

  • Kan følge instruktioner og planlægge dine arbejdsopgaver effektivt

En relevant faglig uddannelse som maler er en fordel. Tilsvarende praktisk erfaring og kvalifikationer kan også komme i betragtning.

Vi tilbyder

Hos TB Enterprise ApS tilbyder vi:

  • Fuldtidsansættelse

  • Varierede maleropgaver

  • Et professionelt arbejdsmiljø

  • Gode kolleger og et tæt samarbejde

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer

  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til kvalifikationer og gældende regler

Arbejdssted

Arbejdet udføres på virksomhedens projekter og hos kunder forskellige steder i Danmark.

Det må forventes, at arbejdsstedet kan variere afhængigt af de aktuelle projekter.

Arbejdstid

Stillingen er på fuld tid, som udgangspunkt 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdstiden aftales nærmere i forbindelse med ansættelsen og tilrettelægges efter de aktuelle projekter.

Løn

Lønnen fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt i overensstemmelse med gældende danske regler.

Ansøgning

Er du interesseret i stillingen, bedes du sende dit CV og en kort ansøgning med oplysninger om din erfaring og relevante kvalifikationer.

Ansøgningen sendes til TB Enterprise ApS.

Vi indkalder relevante kandidater løbende til en samtale.

Om TB Enterprise ApS

TB Enterprise ApS er en dansk virksomhed, der udfører forskellige bygge- og håndværksrelaterede opgaver. Vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ansvarlighed og et professionelt samarbejde.

Vi søger medarbejdere, der ønsker at bidrage aktivt til virksomhedens projekter og virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

title: produktionsmedarbejder 4 dages aftenhold
description:

For vores samarbejdspartner i 8830 Tjele søger Randstad produktionsmedarbejdere til en spændende og alsidig fuldtidsansættelse hos en virksomhed i stor vækst.

Om stillingen
Kan du se dig selv i en produktionsvirksomhed med ansvar for at overvåge, omstille og betjene produktionsanlæg iht. teglstensproduktion? I så fald vil denne stilling være lige noget for dig. Et andet ord for stillingen kunne derfor være operatør, da man har et større ansvar ved produktionsanlæg. Du vil få grundig sidemandsoplæring og det rette introforløb, så du kan bestride arbejdsopgaverne. Dertil en yderst konkurrencedygtig løn.

Aftenholdstider ligger fra 13.55-23.05 4 dage om ugen fra Mandag til Torsdag

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende - men vi ser gerne at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller erfaring. Heroveni er det et plus hvis du har erfaring med betjening af produktionsanlæg og generel procesforståelse. Dette kunne være tidligere arbejde som proces-/industrioperatør og eller smed/mekaniker, med indsigt i fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg. Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har et truckkort, men det er ikke et krav for at søge stillingen.

Arbejdsopgaverne er:
• Overvågning af anlæg
• Omstilling ved produktionsskift
• Kvalitetssikring af anlæg
• Fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg

Vi forventer:
• Du har enten en baggrund og eller erfaring indenfor de ovennævnte områder
• Du er ansvarlig og mødestabil
• Du er selvkørende og selvstændig men kan arbejde i teams

Vi tilbyder:
• Overenskomstmæssige forhold
• Mulighed for faglig udvikling og større ansvar i dine opgaver
• Fastansættelse ved en virksomhed i vækst
• Konkurrencedygtig løn

Ansøg
Hvis du synes, at ovenstående lyder spændende ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Asmus Dam på tlf. 48808201. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt. Vi ansætter snarest mulig.

Om randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: Produktionsmedarbejder daghold
description:
Vil du skabe fremtidens facadebyggeri hos en af Danmarks førende betonspecialister? Kom med på holdet nu

For vores samarbejdspartner i udkanten af Randers søger Randstad forskellige produktionsmedarbejdere til daghold enten fra 05-13, 06-14 eller 07-14. Virksomheden er specialiseret i betonfacadebyggeri, hvor bogen er fuld af ordrer og virksomheden oplever stor fremgang. Så der er brug for flere hænder på holdet!

Du bliver del af et større fællesskab som sammen løfter i hold for at opnå bedst mulige akkordlønning. Dertil får du som medarbejder adgang til eget fitnessrum, omklædningsfaciliteter, kantine, arbejdstøj og tilhørende vaskeservice. Der er tale om et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på fastansættelse.

Det vigtigste for stillingen her er at du har hænderne skruet ordentlig på og har mod på at arbejde med betonelement produktion jævnfør tegninger. Hertil er det en stor fordel hvis du allerede har erfaring fra produktionsverdenen og erfaring med at kunne læse tegninger men ikke en nødvendighed.

Om stillingerne
Vi søger medarbejdere til 3 forskellige teams. Efter en rundvisning kan man selv drøfte, hvilket hold man synes er mest spændende og relevant for ens erfaring, samt hvor virksomhedens behov ligger. Fælles for alle stillinger er en høj grad af frihed under ansvar og muligheden for at blive en del af et professionelt produktionsmiljø hos en virksomhed i stor fremgang.

Du vil få en masse kolleger, som nok skal give dig en god oplæring - hvor du herefter vil indtræde i virksomhedens akkord lønning også kaldet produktivitetsbonus.

Hold 1: Opstiller 05-13
Du kommer til at have din daglige gang i opstiller afdelingen hvor du sammen med dit sjak har til opgave at bygge træforme ud fra tegninger. Herefter indgår du også i opgaven med at udfylde disse forme jævnfør tegninger. Det er derfor en stor fordel hvis du har erfaring med tegningsforståelse eller fra lignende stilling.

Hold 2: Jernbinder 06-14
Her vil du indtræde i armeringsprocessen, hvor man er med til at isolere og lægge armeringsjern i støbeforme inden betonfacaderne skal produceres. Med andre ord skal der klippes, fastspændes og lægges jernstænger i selve støbeformene for at forstærke betonen. Dertil er det også en stor fordel hvis man har noget tegningsforståelse med sig i rygsækken men ikke et decideret krav.

Hold 3: Teglarbejder 06/07-15
Her arbejder du med montage af teglskaller i fliseklæb på liggende elementer samt fugning, hvilket til tider foregår fra lift. Virksomheden oplever stor efterspørgsel på netop disse elementer, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du har et skarpt øje for detaljen og sætter en ære i at levere en god finish.

Din profil
Som sagt skal du ikke nødvendigvis have erfaring. Dog er det en fordel, hvis du har en eller anden form for erfaring inden for produktion og/eller generel brug af værktøj. Du trives med at bruge fysikken på arbejdet og kommer med en god energi til teamet. Dertil bidrager du positivt til fællesskabet og trives med en hverdag, hvor der arbejdes mod fælles mål og produktivitetsbonus. Dertil kræves det at du forstår dansk.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesvilkår
Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at sende dit CV. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Asmus Dam på tlf. 48 80 82 01.

Du starter i et Try & Hire-forløb gennem Randstad, hvorefter du vil overgå til en fastansættelse, såfremt begge parter er indstillet på dette.

Om Randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: Sanitør til erhvervs- og storskade | Bliv en del af Ocab
description:
Når skaden er stor, kræver det et stærkt hold

Når en større brand-, vand- eller anden skade rammer en virksomhed eller ejendom, kan omfanget være betydeligt. Her handler det om at reagere hurtigt, arbejde struktureret og – ikke mindst – løfte opgaven i fællesskab.

Som sanitør inden for erhvervs- og storskade hos Ocab bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer nogle af vores større og mere omfattende skadesager.

Opgaverne kan variere meget i både størrelse og karakter. Nogle dage arbejder du sammen med få kolleger, mens andre sager kræver en større fælles indsats på tværs af fagligheder og funktioner.

Du skal derfor trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaven ikke altid kan forudsiges på forhånd, og hvor godt samarbejde er en vigtig del af at komme sikkert og effektivt i mål.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør bliver du en del af den praktiske indsats på vores erhvervs- og storskadesager. Arbejdet kan være fysisk krævende, og opgaverne kan både foregå indendørs, udendørs og i højden.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger, projektledere og andre faggrupper. Vi forventer, at du tager ansvar for din del af opgaven, har blik for kvalitet og bidrager til, at arbejdet bliver fulgt helt til dørs – også når omfanget er stort, og der skal handles hurtigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Sanering og oprydning efter større brand- og vandskader

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med skader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Håndtering og flytning af indbo, løsøre og inventar

  • Industri- og specialrengøring

  • Dokumentation af det udførte arbejde

  • Arbejde i højden, ex fra lift eller en arbejdsplatform

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

Vi forestiller os, at du

Til denne stilling er det vigtigt, at du trives med at være en del af et hold. På de større skadesager er vi afhængige af, at alle tager ansvar for deres del af opgaven og samtidig hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.

For os handler det ikke kun om erfaring. Vi lægger mindst lige så stor vægt på din indstilling, ansvarlighed, arbejdsmoral og lyst til at lære. Du behøver derfor ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du møder engageret ind, tager ansvar for dit arbejde og bidrager positivt til holdet.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har du erfaring fra skadeservice, byggeri, industri eller lignende, er det en fordel – men det vigtigste for os er din indstilling, din arbejdsmoral og din lyst til at lære

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering – en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Trives med større og til tider komplekse opgaver

  • Er en stærk holdspiller og samtidig kan arbejde selvstændigt, når opgaven kræver det

  • Tager ansvar for din opgave og følger den til dørs

  • Har øje for kvalitet og afleverer et stykke arbejde, du selv kan stå inde for

  • Er i god fysisk form og trives med et aktivt arbejde

  • Er tryg ved at arbejde i højden

  • Bevarer overblikket og den gode indstilling, når tempoet er højt

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdsopgaver, arbejdssteder og arbejdstider

  • Taler og forstår dansk

Har kørekort (kategori B)

En hverdag, der kan ændre sig

Større og akutte skader kan ændre den planlagte arbejdsdag. Arbejdssted, opgaver og arbejdstider kan derfor variere, når situationen kræver det. Udgangspunktet for arbejdstiden er mandag til fredag kl. 07.00 til 15.00.

Deltagelse i vagtordningen er en obligatorisk del af stillingen. Det betyder, at du efter en fastlagt vagtplan skal kunne træde til uden for normal arbejdstid, når en akut skade kræver vores hjælp. Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en ren straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig hverdag med både store og fagligt spændende opgaver

  • En plads på et stærkt hold, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok

  • Ansvar og gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt i takt med opgaverne

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Ocab Farum, Rugmarken 36, 3520 Farum

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

Er du vores nye kollega?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte driftsleder Mickey Heuser på tlf. +45 61 56 58 02.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Unicon søger 3 betonchauffører til Viborg, Holstebro og Skive
description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi betonchauffører til vores fabrikker i Viborg, Holstebro og Skive, hvor der vil være mulighed for at blive tilknyttet en eller flere af disse fabrikker. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Det er ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Viborg, Holstebro eller Skive bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte enten Area Manager, Henrik Walther Larsen, på telefon  +45 2043 4676 eller Plant Supervisor, Casper Sakskjær Nielsen, på telefon +45 2688 4995.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

title: General Manager - Diamond Slice
description:
Diamond Slice — General Manager (Fuldtid / Full-time)

Arbejdssted / Location: Blågårds Plads & Tagensvej, 2200 København N

Stillingstype / Position: Fastansættelse, fuldtid / Permanent, full-time

Ansøgningsfrist / Deadline: Snarest muligt / As soon as possible

Sprog / Languages: Dansk & Engelsk (se nedenfor / see English version below)

DANSK VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, København (Nørrebro)

Trives du i en tempofyldt gæstfrihedskultur, elsker du surdejspizza på højeste niveau, og har du den operationelle rygrad til at drive et hurtigtvoksende restaurantbrand?

Siden åbningen på Blågårds Plads har Diamond Slice redefineret New York-style pizza i København. Med to velbesøgte kvarter-lokationer på Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej 79), en voksende cateringforretning og et markant fodaftryk på Roskilde Festival og sommerevents, søger vi nu en skarp og handlekraftig General Manager.

Som General Manager leder du forretningssiden af Diamond Slice. I tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager og teamledere etablerer du solide systemer, driver FOH-performance og sikrer, at vores lokationer kører gnidningsfrit, effektivt og selvkørende.

Nøgleområder og ansvarsopgaver

  • Forretningsdrift & systemer:

    • Drive den daglige forretningsdrift på tværs af lokationer i tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager.

    • Opbygge, optimere og fastholde pålidelige faste rutiner, systemer og ansvarsfordeling i teamet.

    • Styre bestillingsrutiner, lager og vareoptælling samt træde til og dække for vores Operations Manager ved behov.

    • Opdage flaskehalse i tide og eksekvere praktiske løsninger proaktivt.

  • FOH-ledelse & gæstfrihed:

    • Lede, sparre med og inspirere FOH-medarbejdere og skifteledere.

    • Have det fulde ejerskab over FOH-vagtplanlægning og sikre, at lønmålene konsekvent overholdes.

    • Rekruttere, onboarde og oplære teammedlemmer til Diamond Slices servicestandarder.

    • Håndtere gæstefeedback, kundehenvendelser og daglig kommunikation.

  • Catering, festivaler & vækst:

    • Koordinere indkomne cateringforespørgsler og eventlogistik med Operations Manager og eventteamet.

    • Tage det operationelle ejerskab over Diamond Slices festivalsetups (herunder Roskilde Festival), inklusiv frivillige, bemanding og logistik.

    • Drive lokal forretningsudvikling, samarbejder og community-aktiveringer.

  • Økonomistyring & rapportering:

    • Følge op på det daglige salg, lønomkostninger og dækningsgrader for at identificere optimeringsmuligheder.

    • Klargøre ugentlige løn- og performancerapporter forud for ledelsesmøder.

    • Rapportere drift, bemanding og strategiske forslag løbende til ejerkredsen/bestyrelsen.

Hvem vi søger

  • Dokumenteret erfaring: 2+ års ledererfaring fra tempofyldt restaurationsdrift (f.eks. som General Manager, Assistant GM eller Operations Manager).

  • Systemer & tal: Erfaring med vagtplansystemer, POS/lagerstyring og med at holde lønprocenter inden for budgettet.

  • Hands-on ledelse: Du går forrest under travlhed, bevarer roen under pres og sætter en høj standard for gæstfrihed.

  • Sprog: Professionelt niveau i engelsk er påkrævet (internationalt team). Dansk på samtale- eller flydende niveau er en klar fordel ift. lokal administration og leverandørdialog.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En definerende lederrolle i et af Københavns mest anerkendte pizzakoncepter.

  • Reelt mandat og indflydelse på virksomhedens processer, teamkultur og forretningsvækst.

  • En støttende og sammentømret teamkultur med høj energi og stort fokus på håndværket.

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer samt personalegoder.

  • En fleksibel arbejdsplan.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til work@diamondslice.dk med emnet "General Manager — [Dit Navn]".

ENGLISH VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, Copenhagen (Nørrebro)

Do you thrive in high-energy hospitality, love sourdough pizza made at the highest level, and bring the operational backbone to run a fast-growing restaurant brand?

Since opening on Blågårds Plads, Diamond Slice has redefined New York-style pizza in Copenhagen. With two bustling neighborhood shops in Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej 79), an expanding catering wing, and a major footprint at Roskilde Festival and summer events, we are looking for a sharp, driven General Manager.

As General Manager, you will lead the business side of Diamond Slice. Working in close partnership with our Operations Manager and team leaders, you will establish solid systems, drive FOH performance, and ensure our shops run smoothly, efficiently, and autonomously.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

  • Business Operations & Systems:

    • Drive day-to-day business operations across locations alongside the Operations Manager.

    • Build, streamline, and maintain dependable daily routines, systems, and team accountability.

    • Oversee ordering schedules, inventory, and stock control; step in to cover for the Operations Manager when needed.

    • Spot bottlenecks early and execute practical solutions proactively.

  • FOH Leadership & Hospitality:

    • Lead, mentor, and inspire Front of House staff and shift leaders.

    • Own FOH rota management and ensure labor targets are consistently met.

    • Recruit, onboard, and train team members to Diamond Slice's service standards.

    • Handle guest feedback, inquiries, and daily customer communications.

  • Catering, Festivals & Growth:

    • Coordinate incoming catering requests and event logistics with the Operations Manager and event team.

    • Take operational ownership of Diamond Slice’s festival setups (including Roskilde Festival), including volunteers, staff, and logistics.

    • Drive local business development, collaborations, and community activations.

  • Financial Control & Reporting:

    • Monitor daily sales, labor costs, and operational margins to identify efficiency gains.

    • Prepare weekly labor and performance summaries for leadership meetings.

    • Report regularly on operations, staffing, and strategic proposals to the ownership group/board.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven Track Record: 2+ years of management experience in high-tempo hospitality (e.g., General Manager, Assistant GM, or Operations Manager).

  • Systems & Numbers: Experience managing scheduling tools, POS/inventory setups, and keeping labor percentages on budget.

  • Hands-on Leadership: You lead by example during rushes, bring calm energy under pressure, and set high hospitality standards.

  • Languages: Professional working proficiency in English is required (international team). Conversational or fluent Danish is a strong advantage for local administration and supplier coordination.

What We Offer

  • A defining leadership role in one of Copenhagen’s most celebrated pizza concepts.

  • Real autonomy and influence over company processes, team culture, and business growth.

  • A supportive, close-knit team culture with great energy and high craftsmanship.

  • Competitive salary matching qualifications, and company perks.

  • A flexible schedule.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to work@diamondslice.dk with the subject line "General Manager — [Your Name]".

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
