title: UX/UI Design Lead (m/f/d) (UX-Designer/in)
description:
BIRKENSTOCK is a global brand which embraces all consumers regardless of geography, gender, age and income. The company is deeply footed on a family tradition of shoemaking that can be traced back to 1774. With around 7100 employees worldwide, BIRKENSTOCK is the largest employer in the German footwear industry. To ensure our quality standards, we produce over 95% of our products in Germany and source more than 90% of our materials and components from Europe. The BIRKENSTOCK Group is headquartered in Linz am Rhein and maintains several locations in Germany, as well as sales offices in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia.

Join us in shaping the future at our location in München as a

UX/UI Design Lead (m/f/d)

YOUR SHOES TO FILL:

- Lead the end-to-end UX/UI design process for BIRKENSTOCK's digital products and e-commerce experiences, from discovery and concept validation through wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs. Conduct and support user research activities such as usability testing, surveys, card sorting, or onsite analyses, translating customer insights into measurable product improvements and seamless user journeys.
- Champion a customer-centric design culture by advocating for user needs throughout the product development lifecycle. Partner closely with Product Managers, Development, and QA teams to shape product vision, participate in roadmap discussions, align design solutions with business goals and technical constraints, and ensure accurate implementation of design concepts.
- Own and continuously evolve the BIRKENSTOCK design system, component library, UI standards, and reusable design patterns, ensuring consistency, scalability, accessibility, and usability across platforms, regions, and customer touchpoints. Drive quality assurance for UX and UI execution and maintain design governance and best practices.
- Act as UX/UI expert and primary point of contact within the organization, guiding and sparring with team members, prioritizing projects and workload, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing, and helping build a high-performing, feedback-driven design culture.
- Stay at the forefront of UX, UI, accessibility, and emerging technologies, continuously identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience. Promote and enable the responsible use of AI across the design process, including research synthesis, ideation, content creation, prototyping, workflow optimization, and overall design efficiency.

YOUR WALK OF LIFE:

- 8+ years of professional experience in UX/UI Design, including experience in a Senior, Lead, or comparable role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating expertise across the full product design lifecycle.
- Proven experience designing customer-centric digital products and complex user journeys, ideally within e-commerce, retail, fashion, or lifestyle environments.
- Strong expertise in User Research, User Testing, Interaction Design, Information Architecture, Visual Design, Design Systems, Accessibility, and Design Thinking methodologies.
- Advanced proficiency in Figma and modern design tools, with experience working in Agile product environments and collaborating through tools such as Jira and Confluence.
- Strong understanding of design system management, UX/UI governance, usability principles, accessibility standards, and scalable UI frameworks. Experience maintaining design guidelines, knowledge bases, and reusable design patterns that enable consistent user experiences across international markets and digital touchpoints.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, , and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to present design and UX recommendations, form strategic decisions, and articulate design rationale at all levels of the organization.
- Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and supporting designers, fostering a collaborative and feedback-driven team culture, while helping prioritize workloads and balance project assignments to achieve business objectives.
- Curiosity and openness toward AI, emerging technologies, and innovative design practices, with the ability to evaluate and introduce tools that enhance team productivity and customer outcomes. Passion for staying ahead of UX, UI, accessibility, and AI trends and translating best practices into continuous improvements across the digital customer experience.
- A detail-oriented, hands-on problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset, adaptability in fast-paced environments, and a strong strategic execution approach that balances customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.
- Fluent English is required; German language skills are a plus

WE OFFER:

BIRKENSTOCK offers you all the advantages of a successful, fast growing, global company: dynamic work environment, considerable design freedom, authentic and open corporate culture and excellent development opportunities.

Sounds exciting? It is. Our Talent Acquisition team is looking forward to receiving your online application!

Please hand in your application in English.

title: Lead Spatial Data & Geospatial Engine Architect (m/w/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description:
Lead Spatial Data & Geospatial Engine Architect (m/w/d)

Position: Technische Leitung Geoinformatik, Data-Pipelines & PostGIS-Architektur

Gesellschaft: IRIS - Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung gGmbH

Anstellung: Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder agile Projekt-Entwicklung

Standort: Deutschlandweit / Remote

Über das Vorhaben:

Als technologischer Kern des Iris Instituts verarbeitet unsere Geodaten-Engine bundesweite Kataster-, Netz- und Untergrunddaten. Wir automatisieren das Scraping behördlicher Geoportale (WFS/WMS), aggregieren Vektor- und Satellitendaten (InSAR/TIR) und entwickeln räumliche Algorithmen, um Vorhabenberichte, Restriktionsprüfungen und Eignungs-Dossiers auf Knopfdruck bereitzustellen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Architektur & Core-Engine: Konzeption, Implementierung und Skalierung der zentralen Geodatenbank-Infrastruktur auf Basis von PostgreSQL / PostGIS.
- Automatisierte Daten-Ingestion: Entwicklung robuster ETL- und Scraping-Pipelines (Python, OWSLib, GDAL) zur kontinuierlichen Anbindung amtlicher Geodienste (WFS, WMS, GeoJSON) von BGR, Vermessungs- und Landesämtern.
- Multi-Layer-Verschneidungen: Programmierung hochperformanter räumlicher SQL-Algorithmen (GiST-Indizes, ST-Funktionen) zur Verschneidung von Flurstücken (ALKIS), Restriktionszonen (WHG, Naturschutz), Stromtrassen, Gasleitungen und Aquiferen.
- Document-Mining: Technische Integration von Vision- und KI-Parsern zur Extraktion strukturierter Messwerte aus historischen Bohrloch- und Laborberichten.
- Dossier- & Karten-Automatisierung: Automatisierte Generierung kartografischer Anlagen und strukturierter Datenberichte für Vorprüfungen und Gutachten.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Geoinformatik, Informatik, Vermessungswesen / Geodäsie, Data Science oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Geospatial-Bereich.
- Exzellente Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL / PostGIS sowie performantem Spatial-Query-Design.
- Sicherer Umgang mit Python und Bibliotheken wie GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL/OGR und OWSLib.
- Verständnis der deutschen Geodatenstandards (ALKIS, ATKIS, INSPIRE) sowie Koordinatenreferenzsystemen (ETRS89/UTM, Gauß-Krüger).
- Pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Affinität zu cloudbasierten Open-Source-Architekturen.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse zur sicheren Interpretation behördlicher Daten- und Metadatenstrukturen.

Was wir bieten:

- Eigenverantwortlicher Aufbau einer hochmodernen Geodaten-Infrastruktur auf der grünen Wiese.
- Maximale Flexibilität durch 100 % Remote-Work und agile Arbeitsmodelle.
- Vergütung in Anlehnung an TVöD E13–E15 bzw. marktübliche Tech-Sätze mit Perspektive im Ökosystem.

Bitte richten Sie Ihre Unterlagen zusammengefasst in einem PDF-Dokument per E-Mail an: karriere@iris-institut.de

Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Hydrogeologie; Physischer Geographie; Umwelt-/Bauingenieurwesen; Bergbauingenieurwesen

Position: Wissenschaftliche Bereichsleitung Geowissenschaften, Resilienz & Standort-Erkundung

Über das Vorhaben:

Das IRIS gGmbH erforscht und entwickelt datengetriebene Modelle zur systematischen Bewertung, Absicherung und Erschließung resilienter Industrie- und Infrastrukturstandorte in Deutschland. Wir verbinden amtliche Geodaten (ALKIS, ATKIS, GeolDG), Umwelt- und Katasterinformationen sowie hochauflösende Untergrund- und Satellitendaten (InSAR) zu ganzheitlichen Standortanalysen – von industriellen Hochtemperatur-Wärmespeichern (HT-ATES) über tiefe Aquifere und Brauchwassersicherung bis hin zur Genehmigungsfähigkeit komplexer Liegenschaften.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Wissenschaftliche Gesamtleitung Geo & Umwelt: Fachliche Führung und methodische Weiterentwicklung unserer Forschungsprojekte in den Bereichen räumliche Risiken, Bodennutzung, Wasserdargebot und tiefe geologische Potenziale.
- Standort- & Eignungsanalysen: Fachliche Plausibilisierung und Validierung mehrdimensionaler Standort-Screenings (Schnittmengen aus Geologie, Schutzgebieten nach WHG, Altlasten und Netzinfrastrukturen).
- Bergrecht & Behördenverfahren: Erstellung, Prüfung und zeichnungsberechtigte Einreichung bergrechtlicher Arbeitsprogramme zur Erlangung von Aufsuchungserlaubnissen (§ 7 BBergG) sowie Begleitung von Betriebsplänen (§ 55 BBergG) und wasserrechtlichen Verfahren im Dialog mit Berg- und Fachbehörden.
- Forschungsanträge & Drittmittel: Konzeption und wissenschaftliche Leitung öffentlich geförderter F&E-Projekte (z. B. BMWK Energieforschung, BMBF, EU Horizon) sowie Ausbau von Hochschul- und Institutskooperationen.
- Schnittstelle zu Gutachtern & Banken: Fachliche Begleitung externer Third-Party-Prüfgutachten bis zum Financial Close.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Diplom- oder Masterstudium (Promotion willkommen) in Geowissenschaften, Hydrogeologie, Physischer Geographie, Geoökologie, Umwelt-/Bauingenieurwesen oder Bergbauingenieurwesen an einer deutschen Hochschule.
- Fundierte Praxis in der Anwendung des Bundesberggesetzes (BBergG) und/oder des Wasserhaushaltsgesetzes (WHG) im deutschen Behördenkontext.
- Breites geowissenschaftliches Verständnis für Sedimentbecken (z. B. Norddeutsches Becken, Oberrheingraben, Molasse) und oberirdische Standortfaktoren.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) für rechtssichere Behördeneingaben und Gutachten.
- Offenheit für moderne, daten- und KI-getriebene Methoden der automatisierten Standort-Vorqualifizierung.

Was wir bieten:

- Maßgebliche Gestaltungskraft beim Aufbau eines bundesweit führenden Resilienz- und Geo-Instituts.
- Höchste Flexibilität: Festanstellung, Teilzeitmodell oder freiberufliche Einbindung (auch ideal als wissenschaftliches Advisory-Mandat für Professoren/Hochschuldozenten).
- Attraktive Vergütung in Anlehnung an TVöD E14/E15 bzw. marktübliche Senior-Beratungssätze.
- Vollständig digitale Arbeitsweise und freie Standortwahl.

- Experience in LNG, Oil & Gas, petrochemical or energy projects.
- Experience with stainless steel, carbon steel and cryogenic piping.

title: IT Specialist (f/m/d) 1st Level Server Support France / 1617 (First-Level-Supporter/in)
description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

To ensure an optimal experience and quality of service for our clients, we are looking to strengthen our dedicated French customer support team.

- First Point of Contact: Accompany clients in using our products and services, from understanding their initial request through to full resolution.
- Needs Analysis: Evaluate client inquiries to quickly identify their requirements and deliver clear, efficient, and tailored solutions.
- Technical Support: Assist clients with diverse technical issues and guide them through using our suite of products and services.
- Quality Communication: Maintain high standards of written and verbal communication, adapting your tone and technical level to each client's expertise.

- Team Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues and share knowledge to support the team's overall performance.

Your profile

We have a role for you!

- You have knowledge of UNIX/Linux environments such as Debian, Ubuntu, etc.

- Fluency in English and/or German would be an advantage.

employer: Verein für die Arbeit Mit-Menschen gGmbH
description:
Pädagogische Zusatzkraft (m/w/d) für unsere Tagesgruppe in Landesbergen gesucht
30 Stunden/Woche | ab 15.10.2026

Die Verein für die Arbeit Mit-Menschen gGmbH sucht zum 15.10.2026 eine engagierte pädagogische Zusatzkraft (m/w/d) für unsere Tagesgruppe in Landesbergen mit einem Stellenumfang von 30 Wochenstunden.

In unserer Tagesgruppe begleiten wir bis zu neun Jungen und Mädchen im Grundschulalter an fünf Nachmittagen pro Woche. Gemeinsam schaffen wir einen verlässlichen und strukturierten Rahmen, in dem die Kinder lernen, sich entwickeln und Gemeinschaft erleben können.

Im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit stehen die Gestaltung eines strukturierten Alltags-, Lern- und Freizeitumfeldes, das soziale Lernen in der Gruppe sowie eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit Eltern und Familien.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie begleiten und unterstützen die Kinder im Tagesgruppenalltag und tragen dazu bei, ihnen Sicherheit, Orientierung und verlässliche Strukturen zu geben. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

- Begleitung und Unterstützung der Kinder im Tagesgruppenalltag
- Förderung von Selbstregulation, Selbstständigkeit und sozialer Kompetenz
- Unterstützung bei der Integration in die Gruppe und bei gemeinsamen Aktivitäten
- Mitgestaltung von Lern-, Freizeit- und Gruppenangeboten
- enge Zusammenarbeit mit den pädagogischen Fachkräften im Team
- Beobachtung und Dokumentation der individuellen Entwicklung der Kinder

Das bringen Sie mit

- eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Sozialpädagogische/r Assistent/in oder Kinderpfleger/in
- Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern und Interesse daran, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu begleiten und zu stärken
- idealerweise Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern, insbesondere in der Förderung von Selbstregulation und sozialen Fähigkeiten
- Einfühlungsvermögen, Geduld sowie eine wertschätzende, respektvolle und zugleich klare Kommunikation
- Offenheit gegenüber unterschiedlichen Familienformen, Lebensentwürfen und Lebenssituationen
- eine ressourcenorientierte Haltung und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
- die Bereitschaft, sich mit „Kopf, Herz und Hand“ in die pädagogische Arbeit einzubringen
- Bereitschaft zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung sowie zur Teilnahme an Teambesprechungen und Supervisionen

Das bieten wir Ihnen

- eine Teilzeitstelle mit 30 Wochenstunden mit Schwerpunkt im Nachmittagsbereich
- eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit Kindern im Grundschulalter

title: 587633 Clinical Consultant (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
description:
We are excited to invite a new Clinical Consultant to join our Ultrasound Workspace Service & Support team. If you are passionate about healthcare technology, enjoy representing the company at industry events and help drive innovation by communicating customer needs to product teams we are looking forward to your application.

Your role:

As a Clinical Consultant you will:

- Deliver expert training and support to customers and colleagues, both remotely and on-site, ensuring they are confident and successful with our solutions
- Collaborate closely with project managers to guarantee smooth project delivery and outstanding results for our clients
- Provide hands-on expertise for service contracts and system upgrades, acting as a reliable point of contact for clinical questions
- Represent Philips at industry events, sharing our innovations and building strong professional relationships
- Document your work and product issues accurately, contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing
- Communicate customer needs to our product teams, helping us shape future solutions that truly make a difference
- Support sales activities by delivering engaging product presentations and highlighting the value of our offerings

You should bring the following:

- Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant medical field (ultrasound experience is highly valued)
- At least 3 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 1+ year with a Master’s degree (for example, as a sonographer, in clinical applications, or in customer-facing roles)
- Genuinely interested in IT solutions and passionate about technology
- Remain resilient and constructive under pressure and welcomes feedback as an opportunity to grow
- Self-motivated, proactive, and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team
- Demonstrate excellent customer focus and relationship-building skills
- Clear and confidently communicate in English and have at least B1/B2 level German (with a willingness to further develop language skills).
- Open to international travel, up to 50% of the time

Bonus: Has hands-on experience in medical technology, clinical innovation, or ultrasound equipment (especially in cardiology).

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €81,216.25–€ 108,288.31. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

The salary information shown relates to the location Germany and may differ for other locations.

Benefits include:

- Annual leave: 30 days
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
- Philips “Partnerzeit”: two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products  
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. With patient safety and Quality as our fundamental premise, we focus on regulatory requirements and quality standards in our daily work. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

- Learn more about our business (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about.html) .
- Discover our rich and exciting history (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/our-history.html) .
- Learn more about our purpose (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/environmental-social-governance/our-purpose) .

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here (https://www.careers.philips.com/global/en/diversity-and-inclusion) .

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

description:

- Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

- … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
- … repräsentieren unser Unternehmen bei Kunden, Messen und Veranstaltungen

- Ungarisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Deutsch-, gerne auch Englischkenntnisse
- Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Außendienst
- Freude an der Neukundengewinnung und dem Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Facilities Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management: Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting: Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You: Essential Experience & Skills: Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

Youth Work Ireland is seeking a passionate and motivated Our Generation Youth Worker to join the Our Generation Project in County Donegal. This full-time hybrid role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the mental health, wellbeing, and personal development of young people through innovative youth work programmes. As an Our Generation Youth Worker, you will recruit and engage young people, build strong relationships with schools, youth clubs, and community organisations, and deliver structured programmes including Mind Matters, CHOICE, Stand UPP, and Rise Up. title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

description:

LIMITED is seeking an experienced and skilled Head Chef to lead the kitchen operations of its established food-service business. The successful candidate will be responsible for food preparation, menu development, kitchen supervision, quality control, stock management and compliance with food-safety requirements. This position is within a full-service food establishment and is not based in a fast-food outlet. Key Responsibilities * Lead, supervise and coordinate daily kitchen operations. * Plan and develop menus in accordance with customer demand, seasonal availability and business requirements. * Prepare, cook and present high-quality dishes consistently. * Establish recipes, portion controls and presentation standards. * Allocate duties and supervise chefs, kitchen assistants and other food-preparation staff. * Train and support kitchen employees in cooking techniques, food safety and workplace procedures. * Monitor food quality, taste, presentation and service times. * Manage food purchasing, stock rotation, storage and inventory levels. * Liaise with approved suppliers and ensure the quality and availability of ingredients. * Monitor food costs, portion sizes and kitchen expenditure. * Minimise food waste and support achievement of agreed cost and performance targets. * Develop kitchen preparation schedules based on bookings, expected demand and service requirements. * Ensure compliance with HACCP procedures, food-safety legislation and workplace health and safety standards. * Maintain accurate food-safety, temperature, cleaning and traceability records. * Manage allergen controls and ensure accurate allergen information is available. * Ensure kitchen equipment and food-preparation areas are properly cleaned, maintained and used safely. * Work closely with management and front-of-house staff to ensure efficient service and customer satisfaction. * Assist with recruitment, training, performance management and kitchen-staff scheduling. * Investigate customer feedback relating to food quality and implement corrective actions. * Maintain professional standards during busy service periods. Essential Requirements * At least five years’ professional experience working as a chef at any level. * Previous experience supervising or leading a commercial kitchen team. * Strong knowledge of food preparation, cooking methods, menu planning and kitchen operations. * Good knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene, allergen management and health and safety procedures. * Ability to manage stock, suppliers, food costs and waste controls. * Ability to work effectively under pressure and maintain consistent quality standards. * Good organisational, communication and team-leadership skills.

Deputise for the Aviation Training Team Leader if applicable Essential skills and qualifications Has completed a recognised Traineeship / Apprenticeship in Aircraft Maintenance (Mechanical or Avionics) or Structures and Composites training or completed a Traineeship or Apprenticeship in a technical trade. Must be prepared to pass the relevant EASA Part 66 Modules if you have not passed them already. Experience as a teacher, instructor or trainer, with experience in an EASA Part 147 environment a distinct advantage. Have a good knowledge of EASA Parts 145, 147 and 66. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Be a good team player with demonstrated excellent interpersonal, time management (of assigned tasks and projects) and organisational skill

title: Care Worker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Care Worker Department: Support & Care Salary Scale: €34,350 per annum (rising to €44,000 with service) Responsible To: Team Leader Contract Type: Permanent Location: Ballinode, Co. Sligo Hours of Work: 39 hours per week (Covering a 24 hour, 7 days per week Rotational Shift Roster) ​ About Trinity You are joining Trinity Support & Care Services, an innovative organisation, providing quality assured, safe, and person-centred residential care and outreach support services to children and adults with intellectual disabilities. Key purpose of the job: ​ As a Social Care Worker, you will provide holistic Supports with day-to-day living, for individuals with a learning disability, autism or associated mental health needs. You will deliver person-centred and empowering provisions of support, to meet the individual needs of our service users. ​ Main responsibilities ​ The following duties are typical for this role. The post holder may not perform all of the listed duties and/or may be required to perform additional or different duties from those set forth below to address business needs, changing business practices and/or to meet the needs/changing needs of the Service User. ​ Service User ​ Provide assistance to Service Users in all aspects of personal care. Ensure the Human Rights of each Service User is exercised with the utmost degree of integrity and respect. Ensure a safe environment is maintained at all times for both Service Users, work colleagues and visitors to the unit/house. Ensure each Service User is encouraged to live in accordance with their own wishes and preferences, and their individuality promoted as far as possible, through new opportunities, promotion of skills and innate abilities. Ensure that each Service User receives the correct and relevant information to allow for informed decision making on their part at all levels. Ensure each Service User is supported in the least restrictive of ways and positive risk taking is a given element to their decision-making abilities. Support must also be in accordance with a low arousal and non-aversive manner. Personal outcomes are achieved in keeping with each Service User, with clear goals, steps for achieving such and timeframes. Ensure that supports are prioritised, and key commitments kept accordingly. To work in line with evidence-based practices. To ensure that each person is supported to live life to their fullest potential and remain (or become) socially valued members of their communities. Ensure that you work in a positive manner and professionally contribute to your staff team and wider organisation. If Interested in role, please email your CV to hr@trinityscs.ie. Head Office: Republic of Ireland (ROI) Digi Hub, M-Tek Centre | Armagh Road | Monaghan | | Co. Monaghan | H18 K03 ​

title: Swiss CNC Programmer
description:

     You will be responsible for programming, setting, proving out, and optimizing Swiss-type CNC machines used in the manufacture of precision machined components. The key requirements of this role are developing robust machining processes, improving productivity, troubleshooting manufacturing issues, and maintaining consistent quality while working to tight tolerances across a range of metals and polymers. Competencies Technical qualification or equivalent experience in Precision Swiss Machining, Manufacturing, or related discipline highly desirable. Proven experience as a Swiss CNC Programmer in a high-precision manufacturing environment (medical device experience preferred). Extensive experience programming and setting Swiss-type CNC machines such as: Citizen L and M -Series Traub Series Strong understanding of: · Fanuc Controls · Mitsubishi Controls · Traub TX8i Controls Strong understanding of CNC precision machining and Swiss turning operations. Demonstrated ability to work with tight tolerances (±0.005mm or tighter) and complex geometries. Hands-on experience machining titanium, stainless steel, aluminium, and engineering polymers. Strong communication and teamwork abilities. Key Duties / Responsibilities Develop, test, and optimise CNC programs for Swiss-type CNC machines to produce precision machined components. Perform machine setups, prove-outs, and process validation for new and existing products. Interpret technical drawings and specifications to generate accurate and efficient machining processes. Select appropriate cutting tools, speeds, feeds, and machining strategies for a variety of metals and polymers. Support production by troubleshooting machining, tooling, and process-related issues. Continuously review and improve machining strategies to reduce cycle times, improve surface finish, and optimise tool life. Monitor process performance and implement improvements to increase productivity and process stability. Collaborate with Engineering, Production, and Quality teams to ensure manufacturability, quality, and on-time delivery. Maintain accurate documentation of programs, setup sheets, tooling requirements, and process improvements. Support operator training and provide technical guidance where required. Ensure compliance with ISO 13485 and other applicable quality standards.

title: Deputy Operations Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Hawk's Well Theatre is an inspiring, welcoming and ambitious place to work. This is an exciting period of growth. Alongside our main 340-seat theatre in Sligo, we operate the Art Deco Cinema & Theatre in Ballymote. Keeping two busy venues running safely, smoothly and to a consistently high standard is central to everything we do. Behind every performance is an operation that has to work: a welcoming front of house, a well-run bar, clear procedures, and a team that keeps audiences safe and looked after from the moment they arrive. The role offers variety, responsibility and the chance to help deliver memorable experiences for audiences, artists and visitors across a busy and growing organisation. Working closely with the Operations Manager, the Deputy Operations Manager will help deliver the day-to-day operation of both venues. A central part of the role is taking primary operational responsibility for the bar, alongside direct supervision of the front of house and bar teams. We are looking for a practical, positive and hands-on operational leader. Day-to-Day Operations Support the daily operation of both venues, ensuring activity runs smoothly, safely and to a high standard. Act as Duty Manager as required, including evenings and weekends. Support venue readiness for performances, events, workshops, hires and public activity. Respond calmly and practically to operational issues, resolving them where possible and escalating when appropriate. Provide operational continuity and appropriate decision-making cover in the absence of the Operations Manager. Primary Delivery of Bar Operations. Take primary responsibility for the day-to-day operational delivery of bar services across the organisation. Ensure bar operations are safe, compliant, welcoming and efficiently staffed for each event. Maintain high service standards and ensure compliance with licensing requirements and responsible service of alcohol. Manage ordering, stock control, stocktakes, storage and replenishment of alcoholic and non-alcoholic products. Oversee tills, EPOS process cash procedures and accurate operational records. Monitor costs, reduce waste, support profitability and maintain effective supplier relationships. Prepare bar staffing requirements, shift briefings and post-event reporting Essential Experience & Skills Experience in a front-line operational, supervisory or Duty Manager role Experience managing or supervising bar or hospitality operations, including stock control and service delivery. Experience supervising, supporting and motivating staff teams. Strong understanding of customer-facing environments and excellent standards of customer care. Good working knowledge of health and safety. Sound organisational skills, accurate record-keeping and confidence using tills or EPOS systems. Flexible availability, including evenings and weekends. A full driving licence is required for the role.

title: Operation Specialist
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Operations Specialist leads the planning, negotiation, and delivery of international freight solutions by air, ocean, and road. Main Duties and Responsibilities Plans and designs end-to-end international freight solutions (air, ocean, and road) for complex customer supply chains, using independent professional judgment. Studies customer supply chain needs and turns them into custom, cost-effective, and compliant logistics strategies. • Advanced proficiency in using Barsan's BARSIS system for managing logistics operations, shipment documentation and operational processes. Uses expert knowledge of trade law, sanctions regimes, and customs codes to review and approve shipping and customs documents; advises customers and management on regulatory risk and how to manage it. Selects and evaluates carriers and logistics providers based on cost, performance, and risk; owns vendor performance management. Leads negotiations with carriers and suppliers on freight rates and contract terms, and builds competitive pricing strategies for customer quotes. Directs airline and ocean freight booking strategy to improve service quality, capacity use, and cost efficiency across a portfolio of accounts. Acts as a key operational liaison with customs brokers, government authorities, overseas offices and international business partners across Barsan's global network. Turkish language proficiency is essential for supporting Turkish customers, suppliers and cross-border operations. Coordinates and supports global logistics projects involving multiple countries, ensuring alignment with corporate operational standards, customer requirements and international trade regulations. Owns regulatory compliance for import/export operations, interprets new customs legislation, and turns it into internal procedures. Identifies and manages operational and business risk across international supply chains, and designs plans to prevent and handle problems. Represents the company to public authorities and external agencies to obtain permits and authorizations for regulated or controlled cargo. Acts as the senior point of contact for customers, carriers, suppliers, and business partners, resolving high-value or high-risk issues. Investigates and resolves complex, non-routine operational problems, applying strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Monitors and analyzes operational and business performance data, and leads continuous improvement projects across protfolio. Supervises, trains, and mentors junior operations staff, assigns workload, and gives technical guidance on complex logistics and compliance matters. Speaks fluent Turkish

description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management: Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting: Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You: Essential Experience & Skills: Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

title: Carpenter
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Michael Naughton Carpentry Services is seeking a Carpenter to join a small, hands-on carpentry business based in Cloyne, Co. Cork. This is a good opportunity for someone developing their skills in the trade, working directly alongside an experienced carpenter on a range of residential carpentry and joinery work. The successful candidate will work under the guidance and supervision of the business owner, carrying out general carpentry and joinery tasks including measuring, cutting and fitting timber to specification, assisting with the installation of fixtures such as staircases, doors, and fitted units, working from basic plans and instructions, and maintaining a safe and tidy work area in line with health and safety requirements. Some previous experience in carpentry or general construction is desirable but not essential, full guidance and on-the-job training will be provided. Salary: €36,605 per annum (€18.05 per hour) Hours: 39 hours per week.

title: Evening Caretaker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Bantry (with the opportunity to pick up shifts across West Cork and potential additional hours in Cork) Hours: Monday - Friday 6.30pm - 10.30pm and optional weekends Pay: €15.59 per hour Paid travel to sites Maintenance Operative We are currently recruiting a reliable and proactive Maintenance Operative to support school sites across West Cork, primarily based in Bantry. This is a key onsite role during evening hours, ensuring the safety, security and smooth running of school facilities, particularly during sports events and activities. This role is ideal for a responsible, flexible individual with good practical/DIY skills who enjoys working independently and being a trusted presence onsite. What you will do: Be the onsite point of contact during evening hours (typically 6:30pm–8:30pm on weekdays) Provide site supervision during sports events and occasional weekend tournaments (including potential 12-hour shifts on Saturdays or Sundays) Act as a Fire Warden (training/certification required) Provide basic First Aid assistance in the event of an emergency Support the safe operation of the building, including training in HVAC systems Carry out light maintenance and DIY tasks as required Ensure the premises remain secure, safe and well maintained Report any incidents, hazards or maintenance issues promptly There may also be opportunities to pick up additional shifts across other West Cork schools (particularly if you have access to a car) and potentially in university settings in Cork City. What you will bring: A strong sense of responsibility and reliability Flexibility to work evenings and weekends during school term time Practical DIY or maintenance skills Ability to work independently and respond calmly in emergencies Good communication skills Previous experience as a caretaker, handy person, facilities assistant or fire warden (desirable but not essential) Fire Warden and First Aid certification (or willingness to complete training) Sodexo and our clients are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults within a regulated activity. This role will require applicants to undergo screening appropriate to the post, including checks with past employers and the Garda Vetting. We also offer a range of perks, rewards and benefits for our colleagues and their families: Unlimited access to an online platform offering wellbeing support An extensive Employee Assistance Programme to help with everyday issues or life's larger problems, including legal and financial advice, support with work or personal issues impacting your wellbeing Access to a 24hr virtual GP Service Sodexo Discounts Scheme, offering great deals 24/7 across popular big-brand retailers Save for your future by becoming a member of the Pension Plan Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications

title: Healthcare Assistant (Tipperary)
description:

You will be a healthcare assistant working across our Social Care division. Hours: Full time permanent 40 hours Salary ranges from €33,530 to €36,004, however this may be increased based on Qualifications and Experience What is the Role? You will provide a professional, high quality and safe service as a healthcare assistant to people with additional needs - working as part of a team and in consultation with each service user. You will make sure all of the client's needs are met in a completely individual way, and as an ambassador of Resilience's values, you will represent Best Quality - providing best-in-class care always. Individuality - applying a person-centered approach to meet each individual's abilities, needs and challenges Empowerment - helping all our service-users live their very best life and achieve their optimal potential. What is Required? You will have: FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent; Completed or be willing to complete a Patient Manual Handling course; Eligibility to work in Ireland; A strong sense of empathy, flexibility and a team-oriented work ethic. Previous experience working with adults/children with physical, sensory and intellectual disabilities would be an advantage A Full Drivers Licence is desirable. How Will You Benefit? This is your opportunity to: Develop and progress your career through full induction, training and ongoing development. Enjoy excellent rates of pay Resilience Rewards employee discounts e.g discounted health insurance Make your mark as part of a service that is changing the future of care in Ireland. Employee Assistance Programme 24/7 Resilience4Me Health and Well-being Forum Enjoy a personal, one-to-one approach to social care support work. Benefit from the full support of management. Earn from our paid Refer-a-Friend scheme. FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.
