title: Operational Tax Officer - Tax, Client & Regulatory Reporting (m/f)
employer: Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG, succursale de Luxembourg S.A.E.
description:
Career Opportunities: Operational Tax Officer - Tax, Client & Regulatory Reporting (124954)

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Understand how double taxation treaties work and apply them in practice.
• Analyze the recoverable amount's potential derived from incomes.
• Understand differences between legal structures of clients (e.g., individuals, companies, trusts, etc.) from a tax point of view.
• Manage the entire tax recovery process:
o Prepare tax reclaim requests.
o Complete and gather the relevant documentation in a timely manner, following up on the process until acceptance on the sub-custodian or tax administration side.
o Respond to external requests for information from sub-custodians and tax administrations.
o Reconcile and credit the tax recoverable amounts refunded.
• Collaborate with the Business Process Manager  (BPM) of the service, as well as the IT department, to implement legal and process changes into the tax system tool.
• Ensure all data is up to date in the tax tool to avoid production errors.
• Work in close collaboration with the different teams of the Tax department.
• Handle inquiries and address country-specific tax questions from internal counterparties.
• Analyze potential changes/opportunities in new markets.
• Report to management with recurrent and accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance or Economics.
• Minimum 3 years' experience in the tax department of an audit/tax firm or the back-office department of a bank.
• Very good MS Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Good knowledge of banking systems (e.g., Avaloq).

Soft skills:

• Ability to cope with stress and work in a consistently changing environment.
• Strong team spirit, analytical skills, and results-driven mindset.
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive, autonomous, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

Language skills:

• Fluent in French and English.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.


Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A (m/f)
description:
Description:

Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
Job ID: 10528196 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities

• Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure
• Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
• Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
• Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy
• Onboard, develop and mentor team members in areas of financial reporting for accuracy, create best practice materials and promote knowledge sharing

A day in the life

Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. A significant portion of your time is dedicated to leading Quadrant reporting for Cost-to-Serve, requiring close partnership with Operations teams to ensure alignment and accurate representation of financial impacts.

About the team

Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.
Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or above
• Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
• Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
• Experience in financial modeling

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, or Economics
• Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
• Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
• Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships

title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. About us:

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
You will be part of the Facility Management Department, which covers all activities related to buildings, from the design and project phases to their operation. More specifically, you will join the Operations division which includes the maintenance and operation of the technical installations, managed by a team of four people.

Your role:

Expected services:

Continuously ensuring proper functioning of facilities, good condition of workplaces and user satisfaction. All areas inside campuses are included, particularly laboratories where the infrastructures are linked to sensitive activities with high technological and regulatory requirements. The work environment includes the following: energy production and distribution, HVAC, fluid and gas distribution, sanitary installations, electrical installations. As a maintenance officer in charge of those installations, you ensure their availability, compliance with health and safety regulations and efficient energy use while always being user comfort oriented.
Preventive maintenance of the technical installations covered by this position is outsourced to external providers. For troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on these same installations, the University performs the work both internally and externally depending on their complexity. Given that the University outsources the maintenance of its technical installations, the maintenance levels expected for this position are 1 and 2 (according to French standard NF X60-000 - 2016).

Responsibilities:

• Regular inspections of installations, use of the internal service request processing platform and the CMMS software
• Use of facilities monitoring software, data interpretation
• Support and follow-up of interventions by external service providers, ensuring their execution according to the planned schedule and scope of intervention, e.g., maintenance on the main technical installations: HVAC, electricity, carpentry, periodical inspections, various scale work
• Contribute to solving non-compliance observations made by regulation bodies
• Verification of intervention reports and delivery slips
• Carry out inventory monitoring and ensure proper level of stocks
• Requesting price quotes from external service providers, issuing purchase orders
• Regular reporting to management, provide proposals and recommendations for improvements

Scope of activities:

The work will be performed at one or more of the University's sites. The usual working hours are from 7am to 4pm, Monday to Friday. However, these hours may be adjusted to ensure sufficient team coverage between 7am to 6pm. Depending on the needs, work may also be required between 6am and 10pm or outside of these hours, including, where applicable, Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays. To ensure service continuity, the position is part of the internal on-call organization.

Your profile:

Diploma and professional experience :
Vocational Baccalaureate in HVAC systems or similar, enabling the candidate to perform the expected services. Experience in the relevant fields will be an asset. Qualification for BT-H/V (A) electrical certification.

Required qualities:

• Demonstrate organization and methodical approach in carrying out assigned tasks
• Ability to analyze how technical installations work and the risks of their malfunction
• Proactivity in analyzing failures and responsiveness in corrective interventions
• Ability to work effectively as part of a team, in the common interest, and to report to management
• Committed to providing professional service to users (customer-oriented)
• Demonstrates autonomy and initiative
• Proficient in standard computer applications such as Word and Excel
• Ability to write reports or summaries as needed

Language requirements: Excellent command in French (C1) is essential. The University of Luxembourg is characterized by a multicultural environment. A Good working knowledge of English (B1) is required: B1 level according to the CEFR.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management (m/f)
description:
Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Experience with SQL
• Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
• Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
• Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Description:

The Fund Legal Department is in charge of company secretarial tasks, internal control and corporate governance for the Cayman Islands domiciled subsidiaries of NBL as well as monitoring of the legislation and regulations applicable to our business activities. The Fund Legal Department is also responsible for the legal work in relation to the set-up, restructuring and liquidation of the Cayman investment funds administered by NBL.

In order to support the department, we are looking for a legal officer on a permanent contract.

• Draft various regulatory reporting to Cayman authorities.
• Conduct the risk assessment of the third-party service providers (e.g. external law firms)
• Assess various invoices from the third parties.
• Assist the team to perform certain fund projects (setting up, restructuring and termination of funds).
• Safekeeping of original documents and database maintenance

Job requirements:

• Successful candidates must possess either: (a) an academic background in Studies in Law, with a preference for Luxembourg, European, and/or UK common law jurisdictions. Experience in a legal environment would be a plus; or (b) a minimum of three years of professional experience within a law firm or a legal department of financial institutions or equivalent entities
• Familiar with laws and regulations applicable for global financial institutions
• General knowledge of company secretary functions for companies and internal control
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to share administrative tasks and operational responsibilities with team members to ensure smooth departmental operations.

title: Data Governance Analyst - CDD (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description & Summary
Meet your future team
Join the Central Data Office (CDO), the team responsible for implementing the Firm's Data Strategy, supporting users, fostering the adoption of Data Management best practices, and enabling data that is Trusted, Ready to use and Protected. In this role, you will be part of the Data Governance Operations team, working closely with the Data Governance Unit Leader, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders across the firm.
What your role will look like
As a Data Governance Analyst Associate, you will contribute to the firm's data transformation by helping strengthen Data Governance practices across the organisation. You will support the effective use, protection, quality, and management of data while ensuring Data Governance processes and activities are followed consistently.
• Support the Data Governance Unit Leader and the Data Governance Operations team with Data Governance analysis.
• Ensure the efficient follow-up of requests related to data use across the firm and contribute to the evolution of this activity.
• Oversee data issue management activities and data requirements, including Data Subject requests in collaboration with the Data Protection Office.
• Contribute to the analysis of Data Procedures and assess their impact on Data Governance rules and processes.
• Support the management of the community of Data Owners and Data Stewards and help maintain engagement across stakeholders.
• Perform Data Retention implementation campaigns, including database storage analysis to identify areas with the greatest impact.
• Maintain Data Governance documentation, guidelines and templates, while coordinating meetings, organising logistics, and maintaining accurate records as part of the audit trail.
Your growth and opportunities
You will build practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management practices, and data regulations while contributing to the implementation of the Firm's Data Strategy. The role provides exposure to multiple business domains and stakeholder groups across the firm, helping you broaden your understanding of how data supports decision-making and governance.
The skills you bring
• Master's degree in IT, Data Management, Business Management or Sciences.
• Working knowledge of business analysis and the ability to structure large amounts of information within a process framework.
• Keen to acquire knowledge of Data Management practices (DMBOK), Data Regulation rules (GDPR, RoPA and EU data regulations), and business domains.
• Basic knowledge of Data Architecture, data modelling and database design is considered valuable for the role.
• Fluent in French and English
Ways of working
• Analyse information in a structured way and use data and facts to support informed decisions.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and build trust.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Additional skills that would support your success
• Knowledge of Project Management methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Prince2).
• Knowledge of Product Management practices (ITIL).
The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.
Take your next step
Make a difference by contributing to the way data is governed, protected and used across the firm. Work with colleagues from different teams, build expertise in a growing field, and help shape trusted and reliable data practices. Grow your impact, expand your knowledge, and contribute to meaningful transformation across the organisation. Grow here. Go further.

title: Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department (m/f) – CDI
description:
Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;
• Participate in ICT and security projects;
• Adopting a growth mind-set, promoting a culture of security;
• Excellent team player with proactive and autonomous work ethics;
• Strong analytical skills with attention to details;
• Awareness of professional ethics, risk and compliance;
• Fluent in English

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our Nomura Recruitment Gateway.

Luxembourg
Permanent
Financial Services

My client is looking for a commercially minded and relationship-driven Strategic Treaty Underwriter (F/M)  to join its international P&C reinsurance team. Beyond strong technical underwriting capabilities, this role requires someone who genuinely enjoys being in direct contact with brokers and clients, developing long-term partnerships, and representing the company across international markets.

You will play a key role in developing and managing a diversified treaty portfolio across Europe and Asia, with a strong focus on client engagement, strategic discussions, and market development. The position combines technical underwriting expertise with a highly business-facing dimension, including regular travel and active participation in negotiations and market meetings.

Working within a lean and entrepreneurial environment, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth, reputation, and underwriting excellence of the platform.

Your Key Responsibilities :

Treaty Underwriting & Portfolio Management

• Underwrite and manage complex P&C treaty reinsurance business in line with underwriting strategy and risk appetite.
• Assess exposures across Property and Third-Party Liability lines, including catastrophe-exposed business.
• Structure and price treaty programs using actuarial analysis, catastrophe models, and underwriting judgement.
• Monitor portfolio performance, accumulations, and profitability metrics to support sustainable and profitable growth.

Client & Market Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with brokers, cedants, and business partners across international markets.
• Act as a key contact for clients, ensuring responsiveness, commercial understanding, and long-term partnership development.
• Represent the company during client visits, market meetings, renewals, negotiations, and industry events.
• Identify new business opportunities and contribute to the growth of the treaty portfolio across targeted regions.

Strategic Contribution & Collaboration

• Work closely with actuarial, claims, risk management, and finance teams to support portfolio steering and underwriting governance.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of underwriting tools, processes, and best practices.
• Support and mentor junior team members where appropriate.
• Actively contribute to the overall excellence and development of a dynamic and collaborative organisation.

Your Profile :

• 7+ years of experience in P&C treaty reinsurance underwriting.
• Fluent in English
• Strong exposure to international markets, ideally across Europe and/or Asia.

description:
Job Description & Summary
Meet your future team
Join the Central Data Office (CDO), the team responsible for implementing the Firm's Data Strategy, supporting users, fostering the adoption of Data Management best practices, and enabling data that is Trusted, Ready to use and Protected. In this role, you will be part of the Data Governance Operations team, working closely with the Data Governance Unit Leader, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders across the firm.
What your role will look like
As a Data Governance Analyst Associate, you will contribute to the firm's data transformation by helping strengthen Data Governance practices across the organisation. You will support the effective use, protection, quality, and management of data while ensuring Data Governance processes and activities are followed consistently.
• Support the Data Governance Unit Leader and the Data Governance Operations team with Data Governance analysis.

• Oversee data issue management activities and data requirements, including Data Subject requests in collaboration with the Data Protection Office.
• Contribute to the analysis of Data Procedures and assess their impact on Data Governance rules and processes.
• Support the management of the community of Data Owners and Data Stewards and help maintain engagement across stakeholders.

Your growth and opportunities
You will build practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management practices, and data regulations while contributing to the implementation of the Firm's Data Strategy. The role provides exposure to multiple business domains and stakeholder groups across the firm, helping you broaden your understanding of how data supports decision-making and governance.
The skills you bring
• Master's degree in IT, Data Management, Business Management or Sciences.
• Working knowledge of business analysis and the ability to structure large amounts of information within a process framework.
• Keen to acquire knowledge of Data Management practices (DMBOK), Data Regulation rules (GDPR, RoPA and EU data regulations), and business domains.

• Fluent in French and English
Ways of working
• Analyse information in a structured way and use data and facts to support informed decisions.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and build trust.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Additional skills that would support your success
• Knowledge of Project Management methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Prince2).
• Knowledge of Product Management practices (ITIL).
The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.
Take your next step
Make a difference by contributing to the way data is governed, protected and used across the firm. Work with colleagues from different teams, build expertise in a growing field, and help shape trusted and reliable data practices. Grow your impact, expand your knowledge, and contribute to meaningful transformation across the organisation. Grow here. Go further.

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;

Join a global financial services firm where your work helps strengthen trust in the financial system and supports how we serve clients worldwide. You will build relationships, shape governance routines, and help ensure critical deliverables are tracked and closed with discipline.

As an AML Governance & Oversight Associate, 1st Line of Defense within our Outsourcing, Operations, and Technology organization, you will help coordinate the governance cadence that keeps anti-money laundering actions, regulatory and audit deliverables, and escalation items controlled, evidenced, and closed on time—working closely with first and second line partners across the firm.

Job responsibilities

• Support the AML 1LoD Lead as the business/operations interface to 2LoD/GFCC by coordinating inputs, aligning expectations, and surfacing key decisions, risks, and dependencies for action/escalation.
• Maintain the single source of truth for AML matters, including the JPMSE AML Areas of Concern and the Issue/Action Register, ensuring clear ownership, target dates, dependencies, and documented closure evidence/status.
• Identify, triage, and track emerging AML risks/issues (1LoD lens), prepare concise escalation summaries, and monitor escalations through to closure in line with agreed governance.
• Support the coordination and quality-check regulatory RFIs end-to-end (intake, scoping, stakeholder outreach, drafting coordination, and evidence collation) and produce final response packs for AML 1LoD Lead review and sign-off.

• Coordinate the AMLA data questionnaire by managing inputs, challenge/validation, tracking, evidence collation, and final pack preparation for sign-off.
• Support AML New Product Assessment activities by coordinating required inputs, tracking actions, and preparing evidence/assessment materials for AML 1LoD Lead review.
• Support regulatory strategy and change monitoring by tracking regulatory change and industry developments impacting JPMSE; maintaining a regulatory change/watch-items tracker (aligned with 2LoD) with actions, owners, and dates; and reporting progress on a regular cadence.
• Provide programme/project governance support (plans, RAID logs, milestones, governance updates), with particular focus on the EU AML Reform Program for Outsourcing.
• Run the quarterly BAU cycle for AML Outsourcing Framework maintenance (including the Outsourcing Register) and coordinate regulatory notifications for new outsourcing.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

• Demonstrable experience operating within a 1LoD control environment, issue management, governance forums, escalation, evidence discipline, and sustainable remediation.
• Experience in AML and/or wider Financial Crime topics (e.g., AML governance, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, fraud) and how these translate into business/operations requirements.
• Experience coordinating responses to regulatory requests and/or audits (RFIs, evidence packs, walkthrough coordination), with strong attention to defensibility and consistency of messaging.
• Ability to manage data quality in a controlled way (data sourcing understanding, reconciliations/checks, exception tracking, root cause themes, and prevention), ideally for regulatory submissions/questionnaires.
• Able to influence and drive outcomes across Business, Operations, Technology and 2LoD partners (including GFCC), including confident follow-up and escalation where required.
• Proven ability to run multiple workstreams concurrently, maintain trackers and governance cadence, and drive actions to closure under tight timelines and competing priorities.
• Strong written and verbal skills, produces concise, senior-ready updates and materials that are audit/regulator appropriate.
• Excellent Microsoft office skills, Excel ,Power Point and Word.

title: Executive Assistant - CDI - Full-Time - (M/F/X)
description:
Executive Assistant – Corporate Governance & Board Support (M/F/X)

About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission

As an Executive Assistant reporting to the General Secretary, you will serve as the primary point of coordination for the CEO's office, managing the executive diary, organising leadership meetings and ensuring seamless communication between the CEO, internal teams and external stakeholders. You will also play a central role in corporate governance by coordinating Board of Managers meetings and General Assemblies and maintaining compliance with Luxembourg's legal obligations.
You will combine high-level administrative expertise with strong organisational skills to support the agency's leadership team in delivering on Luxinnovation's mission.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire: Representing the leadership and enhancing institutional visibility
• Welcome and accompany VIP visitors, ensuring a professional and seamless experience
• Coordinate internal and external events organised by the CEO's office and the broader leadership team
• Prepare briefing documents, background notes and speaking points for the CEO's external engagements
• Support the CEO's institutional representation at high-level meetings and conferences

Assess & Accelerate: Driving operational excellence across the executive office
• Manage the CEO's diary: schedule appointments, meetings and professional travel (transport, accommodation, programmes, visa formalities where required)
• Process and validate travel-related expense reports
• Collect, consolidate and track information for the CEO on ongoing projects, events and pending requests
• Organise semi-annual and annual performance review meetings between the CEO and direct reports
• Manage and validate leave and telework requests from the CEO's direct reports
• Ensure administrative follow-up: filing, archiving and document management

Connect: Facilitating seamless communication and cross-departmental coordination
• Plan and coordinate leadership meetings: Management Committee (MCM), Staff Meetings, Managers Meetings
• Coordinate across Luxinnovation's departments to ensure fluid communication between the leadership team, staff and external partners
• Manage incoming communications: handle phone calls, emails and relay critical information to the appropriate stakeholders
• Provide ad hoc administrative support to members of the leadership team as needed

Fund: Supporting corporate governance and institutional compliance
• Plan and organise Board of Managers meetings (Conseils de gérance) and General Assemblies
• Prepare corporate governance documents: agendas, attendance lists, proxy forms, General Assembly minutes, official convocations and draft presentations
• Prepare documentation packs and dispatch official convocations and correspondence within statutory deadlines
• Coordinate logistics and room reservations for governance meetings
• Maintain and monitor legal obligations with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion

This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

Required competencies

Education level and professional experience required:
• No specific diploma is required; relevant professional experience is the primary criterion
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in a similar executive assistant, office management or corporate governance coordination role, ideally within a C-suite environment

Specific competencies:
• Demonstrated experience in C-suite diary management and complex travel coordination
• Solid knowledge of corporate governance processes: board meetings, General Assemblies, minute-taking and statutory filings
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
• Strong written and verbal communication skills across multiple stakeholder levels
• High degree of discretion and ability to handle confidential information
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a keen eye for detail
• Experience coordinating cross-departmental workflows and acting as a liaison between leadership and operational teams

Languages:
• Fluent English and French are mandatory
• Luxembourgish or German is a significant asset

IT skills:
• Strong command of the Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
• Very good knowledge and confident use of online tools for travel bookings, reservations, expense management and collaborative platforms

Why choose this position?
This is a unique opportunity to work at the heart of Luxembourg's national innovation agency, directly supporting the leadership team in shaping the country's innovation ecosystem. You will gain first-hand exposure to high-level strategic discussions, corporate governance and cross-departmental coordination. If you want your organisational skills to make a tangible impact, this role offers a genuinely rewarding professional opportunity within a collaborative and forward-looking institution.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their application showing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

title: Advanced Materials Engineer, Global Materials Science (m/f)
description:
Description:

Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
• Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
• Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes.
• Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
• Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
• Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.
EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment
• Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
• Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
• Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
• Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.
Automation Hardware Integration
• Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
• Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
• Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
• Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.
Materials Characterization & Testing
• Perform and direct lab engineers to conduct comprehensive materials characterization of physical, structural, strength, resistance, surface, optical, barrier, and recyclability properties while utilizing standards and non-standard methodologies.
• Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
• Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
• Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base.
Specifications & Quality
• Define materials specifications based on critical performance thresholds required for packaging to protect products and survive the fulfillment network, accounting for EU-specific substrate variability and supplier capabilities.
• Translate operational requirements and automation equipment constraints into measurable materials properties and acceptable ranges.
• Develop quality control protocols and testing methodologies to ensure EU supplier compliance with specifications, accounting for differences in regional testing standards.
• Drive specification harmonization between NA and EU where feasible, clearly documenting where and why regional deviations are necessary.
Supplier & Manufacturing Collaboration
• Work directly with EU-based paper mills, converters, and other suppliers to develop and scale new paper-based packaging materials.
• Conduct technical evaluations of EU supplier capabilities, pulp and paper manufacturing processes, converting operations, and quality control systems.
• Guide suppliers on process optimization—from pulp preparation and paper machine settings through converting and finishing operations—to achieve target material properties and consistency.
• Build strong technical relationships across the EU supplier base to enable rapid development cycles and ensure supply resilience.
Cross-Functional Partnership
• Collaborate with Packaging Design and automation hardware teams on materials-design-equipment integration, ensuring all three dimensions are optimized together.
• Partner with EU and Global Procurement (GPO) on strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and commercial negotiations within the EU supply base.
• Support sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint modeling, recyclability assessment, and compliance with EU-specific sustainability regulations and reporting requirements (REACH, EU PPWR, CEFLEX).
• Provide technical expertise to program managers, product teams, and deployment teams across both EU and NA organizations.
• Communicate complex materials science and manufacturing concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences across multiple geographies and cultures.
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
• Author technical reports, test protocols, specifications documents, and research summaries that serve both EU and global audiences.
• Document experimental procedures, results, and learnings to build institutional knowledge, with particular emphasis on EU-NA materials differences and lessons learned.
• Present findings at design reviews, technical workshops, and leadership reviews across regions.
• Contribute to intellectual property generation through public disclosures and patent applications.
• Mentor junior engineers and technicians on materials science principles, pulp and paper manufacturing fundamentals, converting operations, and testing methodologies.
This role sits at the intersection of materials science, manufacturing processes, automation engineering, and global supply chain strategy. Your holistic understanding of how pulp becomes paper, how paper becomes packaging, and how packaging runs through automated systems makes you uniquely positioned to solve problems that span traditional disciplinary boundaries, all while keeping EU and NA aligned on a simplified, high-performing materials portfolio.
Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.
Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.
What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster [...]

title: Job på Malta - Vil du arbejde med administrativ kundeservice med Igaming? - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

title: Kundenservice / Online Presenter (Koreanisch & Englisch) – Malta (Kundendienstberater/in)
description:
Für einen internationalen Technologie- und Entertainment-Kunden in Malta suchen wir koreanischsprachige Kandidaten für eine kundenorientierte Online-Rolle in einem professionellen Studio-Umfeld.
Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – eine umfassende Schulung wird angeboten.

We are recruiting Korean-speaking Online Presenters / Customer Service Representatives for a global technology company based in Malta.

In this role, you will work from a professional studio environment, engaging with online users and delivering a high-quality, interactive digital experience. No previous experience is required — full training is provided.

Key Responsibilities

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio
- Engage with users in a professional, friendly, and customer-focused manner
- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Hierbij adviseer je de organisatie over hoe men de alledaagse praktijk kan verbeteren. Je bent daarnaast bezig met het schrijven van beleidsplannen en het adviseren van de organisatie. Offer Description
Understanding how patterns of neural activity give rise to behavior is a central challenge in neuroscience. Most of what we know about this relationship comes from rodent experiments performed under tightly controlled laboratory conditions. While these approaches are essential for identifying neural mechanisms, they capture only a fraction of the behavioral repertoire animals display in more complex environments.
What are you going to do?
In this project, you will investigate how neural population activity relates to behavior across environments ranging from standardized laboratory assays to large outdoor enclosures. Using miniaturized calcium imaging, you will record the activity of large populations of neurons in freely behaving mice and determine how neural activity relates to moment-to-moment behavioral changes.
A major component of the project will make use of large outdoor mouse enclosures at the University of Groningen. These environments allow mice to express a rich repertoire of species-typical behaviors, including exploration, shelter use, social interactions and responses to changing environmental conditions. Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. title: PHD Candidate Towards a Tiered Risk Assessment Strategy
description:
PhD Candidate Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. The complementary PhD project at Utrecht University will investigate other potential adverse health effects, including neurotoxicity, cardiotoxicity and effects on the blood-brain barrier.
