title: PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics
description:
About the position

Integreat - the Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at the University of Oslo invites applications for a doctoral research fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics. We seek a motivated researcher, who values collaboration, inclusivity, and impact, and who would like to contribute to a supportive, interdisciplinary research environment with strong focus on mentoring and career development.

Starting date upon agreement, and no later than 31 January 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at University of Oslo at Blindern, Oslo.

We welcome applicants with a strong background in machine learning and statistics, who are eager to contribute to cutting-edge methods for generating private and fair synthetic data with good utility. This project involves development of deep learning based synthetic data generators that obtain both good utility and protection of privacy, through tailored model approximation, as well as new measures of privacy and fairness to be used for assessing properties of synthetic generators, or in loss functions for training them. Further, the potentials and limitations of the developed approaches should be critically assessed regarding their implications for fairness, privacy, and utility. This project is at the intersection of machine learning, statistics and ethics.

This position is affiliated with the research group research group in Statistics and Data Science at the Department of Mathematics at University of Oslo, in close collaboration with the machine learning group at the Department of Informatics.


About Integreat

See the video for more information about Integreat.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-_I52cJHiW4About Integreat 

Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research Council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). This position is in Oslo.

Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore it is a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world. Integreat develops theories, methods, models, and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. We do this by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technology, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

The focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and therefore solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, statistics, data science, mathematics, or related field
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Employment and admission to the PhD programme are conditional upon successful completion of the Master's degree and submission of official documentation confirming that the degree has been awarded. Applicants who are in the final stages of completing their Master's degree may still apply.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with deep learning models
  • Strong background in programming
  • A keen interest in considering and discussing ethical aspects of the research projects
  • Experience with interdisciplinary work

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements: 

The norm is as follows:

  • the average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Supplementary Regulations at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences to the Regulations for the Degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo - The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


Personal skills

We are looking for candidates who are curious, open-minded, and motivated to learn. You should enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and be comfortable communicating your ideas clearly across disciplines. A collaborative spirit, a strong sense of responsibility, and a willingness to contribute to an inclusive and respectful research culture are essential.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

Integreat is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging, guided by our INTEGREAT principles (Integrity, Non discrimination, Tact, Environment, Gratitude, Respect, Empathy, Accountability, Transparency). We embed these values in practice through inclusive hiring and structured evaluations, targeted mentoring and career development, and flexible work arrangements and accommodations to ensure everyone can thrive and contribute.

We particularly welcome applications from women and gender minorities who are underrepresented in STEM, as well as applicants with immigrant backgrounds, disabilities, non linear career paths, or career breaks. We will take career interruptions and diverse career trajectories into account during evaluation.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.


We offer
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK 550 800 – 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A unique research environment with multiple opportunities to develop research themes at the forefront of modern science
  • A friendly, inclusive, and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives
  • Access to a strong network of top-level national and international collaborators
  • A reliable and generous pension agreement, along with strong public benefits
  • Comprehensive welfare schemes supporting both personal and professional well-being
  • Full access to public health services through membership in the National Insurance Scheme
  • A vibrant academic environment with an active and supportive research community
  • Structured career development programmes at the faculty level and an individual professional development plan throughout the postdoctoral period
  • Mentoring and support structures tailored to early-career researchers
  • Flexible working conditions, with understanding for different life situations and family responsibilities
  • Research mobility funds supporting short research stays and international collaboration
  • Family-friendly surroundings in Oslo and Tromsø, with rich opportunities for culture, nature, and outdoor activities
  • A clear institutional commitment to gender equality and diversity, with dedicated initiatives and networks for women in science

Integreat provides a researcher training programme, INTREF - the Integreat Young Researchers’ Forum - a fellow driven initiative offering scientific training, transferable skills workshops, mentorship, research visits, and career development support.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter – describe your motivation for pursuing a PhD at Integreat and in Norway, with particular emphasis on your research interests and academic achievements to date relevant for this position and the project
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • If relevant you may attach Master thesis or a draft of your thesis
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Documentation of English proficiency

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

Integreat – Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning - Integreat is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world.

Integreat develops theories, methods, models and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. This will be done by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technologies, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

Focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and by this solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.

title: Rådgjevar bedriftsmarknad - pao Voss
description:
Rådgjevar bedriftsmarknad - pao Voss

Likar du å arbeida med folk, økonomi og ha gode kundemøte?
Er du typen som ser ei oppgåve som må gjerast, og berre gjer det?
Då vil me gjerne høyra frå deg.

Voss Sparebank er ein sjølvstendig lokal sparebank med 28 tilsette.

Me kjenner kundane våre, me kjenner kvarandre – og me likar å gjera lokalsamfunnet til ein betre plass å bu og leva.

No ser me etter ein ny kollega som skal vera rådgjevar for bedriftsmarknaden
på Voss og nærområdet vårt.

Hjå oss får du ikkje berre kontorpult, stol og PC i moderne lokale.
Du får høve til å bli kjend med verksemdene i lokalsamfunnet, forstå kva dei driv med og vera ein viktig sparringspartnar når dei skal investera, utvikla seg eller ta nye steg.

Ingen dagar er like. Nokre dagar sit du fordjupa i ein kredittsak. Andre dagar er du ute og møter ein kunde, diskuterer investeringar over ein kaffikopp eller finn ut korleis me kan hjelpe ei lokal bedrift vidare.

Om du trivst med ansvar, relasjonar, tykkjer om samfunnsoppdraget vårt og likar at arbeidsinnsatsen din vert opplevd som meiningsfull. Då er dette kanskje ei stilling for deg?

Arbeidsoppgåver
Som rådgjevar på bedriftsmarknaden får du ansvar for eiga kundeportefølje.
Du vil mellom anna:
  • Rådgje og selja banken sine produkt og tenester til eksisterande og nye bedriftskundar – kreditt, forsikring, leasing, pensjon og sparing/plassering
  • Følgja opp og utvikla gode kunderelasjonar
  • Vurdera kreditt, utarbeida og presentera kredittsaker
  • Vera ein aktiv sparringspartnar for kundane våre og forstå behova deira
  • Oppsøkja nye kundar og byggja nettverk i næringslivet
  • Samarbeida med kollegaer i heile banken for å finne gode og heilskaplege løysingar
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Du har høgare utdanning innan økonomi.
  • Du er tidleg i karrieren, eller er nyutdanna.
  • Det er òg fint om du har interesse for, eller erfaring frå finans, rekneskap
    eller revisjon.
  • Du har interesse for lokalt næringsliv.
  • Du er god til å skriva nynorsk eller villig til å læra det.
  • Det er eit pluss om du har autorisasjonar frå FinAut.
    Om du ikkje har det, må du på sikt vera motivert for å gjennomføra autorisasjon i kredittfaget.
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Du likar å snakka med folk og skapa tillit.
  • Du er nysgjerrig på bedrifter, menneske og økonomi.
  • Du kan analysere tal, men også forstå menneska bak tala.
  • Du ser kva som må gjerast og tek i eit tak når det trengst.
  • Du trivst med kundekontakt og nettverksbygging.
  • Du er ein god kollega som ser dei rundt deg,
Me tilbyr
  • Mange gode og dyktige kollegaer og ein triveleg arbeidsplass.
  • Ei rådgjevarrolle med både ansvar og tillit.
  • Flotte og moderne lokale midt i Voss sentrum.
  • Eige treningsrom – fordi me trur det er viktig å ta vare på både hovudet og kroppen.
Om Voss
Her har du kort veg til fjell, ski, sykling, fjord og andre friluftsaktivitetar – samstundes som Voss har eit rikt idretts- og kulturliv gjennom heile året.
For deg som likar å vere aktiv, møte folk og ha naturen tett på, er Voss ein fin plass å både bu og jobba.

Om Voss Sparebank
Her kan du lesa meir om banken :
www.vossabanken.no

Spørsmål
Har du spørsmål om stillinga, ta kontakt med:
Leiar bedriftsmarknad Kurt Arild Midtun: 479 30 327
Banksjef Jørund Rong: 479 30 335

Ynskjer du å bli vår nye rådgjevar for bedriftsmarknaden på Voss, sender du ein kortfatta søknad med CV til Voss Sparebank på e-post: kam@vossabanken.no. (mrk: «Bedriftsrådgjevar» i emnefeltet) eller bruk søknadsskjemaet via "søk på stilling" knappen på denne siden.

Søknadsfrist er 20.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Voss Sparebank vart etablert i 1843.
Sidan starten og fram til i dag, har banken utvikla seg til ein moderne bank som tilbyr eit vidt spekter av produkt og tenester innanfor daglegbank, finansiering, sparing og forsikring.

title: Researcher in Solar Physics
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position at the Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics (RoCS) at the Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics (ITA).

The position is for a period of 2 years.

Starting date is flexible between 1st of January 2027 and 1st of October 2027.

Place of work is Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics, Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Researcher Project for Early Career Scientists (FRIPRO) “MultiSCORE: Multi-scale structure of the coronal environment” and led by Petra Kohutova. The MultiSCORE project focuses on the formation of large- and small-scale structure in the solar corona and combines high-resolution solar observations with numerical modelling. The successful candidate will contribute to the observational aspect of the project using multi-vantage-point observations of the solar corona from Solar Orbiter and the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). The candidate will work on the analysis of fine-scale structure in the corona using Solar Orbiter/EUI imaging and SPICE spectroscopic data, and on reconstruction of three-dimensional structure of active regions by combining multi-vantage-point Solar Orbiter and SDO/AIA observations with constraints from magnetic field extrapolations. Observational results will be compared with synthetic observables from numerical models. The candidate will be expected to participate in the dissemination of the research results through journal publications and conference presentations in Solar Physics and Astrophysics as well as through outreach activities.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Solar Physics, Astrophysics, or a closely related field. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Experience with Solar Orbiter data analysis
  • Programming skills in Python/IDL/Julia

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with scaling and intermittency analysis techniques applied to solar or space plasma observations and/or simulations is an advantage
  • Experience with coronal magnetic field extrapolation methods is an advantage
     

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 595 000 - 690 000 depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

title: PhD Candidate in Trustworthy Agentic Artificial Intelligence
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Would you like to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, autonomy and maritime technology, contributing to AI systems that are safe, transparent and accountable? The Department of ICT and Natural Sciences at NTNU in Ålesund has a vacancy for a PhD Candidate in trustworthy agentic artificial intelligence. The PhD research project is part of the new Norwegian Maritime AI Center, led by NTNU.

Agentic AI systems are moving rapidly from research prototypes into real-world applications. In safety-critical domains such as maritime operations, their adoption depends on whether their behaviour and decisions can be understood, verified, constrained, and audited. This is particularly challenging when using closed, proprietary models, where model weights, training data, and internal representations are inaccessible.

The PhD project will therefore investigate how trustworthy agentic AI systems can be developed using open-weight models. Access to model weights enables the candidate to inspect and adapt the models, investigate their internal representations, apply interpretability and verification methods, fine-tune and align them for specific operational domains, and deploy them locally under full control of sensitive operational data.

A central maritime use case will be condition monitoring and predictive maintenance of ships and maritime systems. Modern vessels generate large amounts of heterogeneous operational data from sensors, machinery, control systems, maintenance records, and other sources. The candidate will investigate how agentic AI can autonomously interact with such data and relevant engineering tools to identify abnormal behaviour, reason about possible faults, assess equipment condition, and support maintenance decisions. For example, an AI agent could combine sensor measurements and historical maintenance information, invoke diagnostic or predictive models, identify evidence of component degradation, and recommend appropriate maintenance actions.

The position offers the opportunity to conduct cutting-edge research in trustworthy and agentic AI within a growing AI research environment, with access to relevant maritime expertise, data, and use cases and strong links to the Norwegian maritime industry.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.
 


About the project

The center shall position the maritime sector for accelerated and successful use of AI. The demand for safe and sustainable maritime activities, as well as the shortage of crew and engineers, are key drivers for change in the maritime sector. At the same time, there is a pull for growth, increased efficiency and profitability, while managing volatility in the markets. Moreover, the sector is critically important for global supply chains and security in a tense geopolitical situation. To demonstrate and prototype maritime AI solutions, the center will address a diverse and impactful set of use cases: Logistics, shipping and business transactions; Ship design and construction; Voyage planning and optimization; Condition monitoring and maintenance; Crew training; Maritime traffic and ship surveillance; Decarbonization and energy management; Autonomous ships and remote control.

The research partners are the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), University of Oslo, Oslo School of Architecture and Design, Royal Norwegian Naval Academy, Norwegian Mapping Authority, MET and SINTEF Nordvest. There are about 30 user partners from the maritime sector, in addition to hundreds of members of the Maritime Forum, Blue Maritime, Ocean Autonomy, and Maritime CleanTech clusters. The center will be a hub, orchestrating the interfaces with research partners and user partners to facilitate collaboration, knowledge creation, dissemination, innovation, and sharing of knowledge. The Norwegian Maritime AI Center is funded by the Research Council of Norway and the partners for the period 2026-2030. There will be approximately 25 doctoral scholarships and some postdoc positions. More information can be found here: Norwegian Maritime AI Center.
 


Duties of the position
  • Conduct research on trustworthy agentic AI built on open-weight foundation models, including agent architectures, reasoning, planning and tool use, and the efficient adaptation of open models for locally deployed, domain-specific use.
  • Develop and evaluate methods that make agent behaviour reliable and accountable, such as uncertainty quantification, interpretability, alignment, monitoring and human oversight, taking into account relevant standards and regulation, including the EU AI Act.
  • Validate the developed methods on realistic case studies in maritime and other safety-relevant applications, in collaboration with the Maritime AI Center and industry partners.
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above, including academic publications and popular science dissemination.
  • Participate in the research group Cyber-Physical Systems Laboratory (CPS Lab) and Norwegian Maritime AI Centre activities.
  • Take courses in relevant technical topics, comprising a minimum of 30 ECTS.
     

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, engineering cybernetics, applied mathematics, electrical engineering, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's doctoral programme in Engineering Cybernetics.
  • Strong programming skills, in particular Python, and practical experience with modern machine learning frameworks.
  • Applicants from non-English speaking countries outside Europe must present an official language test report. The acceptable tests are TOEFL, IELTS, and Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE). Minimum scores are:
    • TOEFL: 600 / writing 4.5 (paper-based) or 92 / writing 22 (internet-based)
    • IELTS: 6.5, with no section lower than 5.5 (only Academic IELTS test accepted)
    • CAE/CPE: grade B or A.
       

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience with agentic AI systems, LLM-based agents, tool use, planning, or multi-agent systems.
  • Knowledge of trustworthy AI topics such as interpretability, explainability, uncertainty quantification, robustness, formal verification, safety, privacy or AI governance and regulation.
  • Familiarity with maritime, autonomous systems, or other safety-critical application domains.
  • Demonstrated research ability, e.g. through publications, thesis work, technical reports or open-source contributions.
  • Relevant industry or applied research experience.
     

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

  • Work independently and in a structured way, as well as collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team
  • Communicate effectively and present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed.
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Cybernetics within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis. The place of service is NTNU in Ålesund.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page).
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work.
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Agus Hasan, telephone +47 934 61 014, email agus.hasan@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Gunn-Helen Hellevik, gunn.hellevik@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 31.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

Ålesund, known for its unique Art Nouveau architecture and spectacular nature, is a gem on Norway's west coast. The city offers a vibrant cultural life, modern facilities, and a dynamic business environment. With its strategic location by the sea, Ålesund provides a perfect balance between urban living and natural experiences. Here, you will find excellent schools, top-notch healthcare services, and a wide range of recreational activities. Ålesund is an ideal place for both career and family life, with a safe and inclusive community.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

Our research areas include autonomous vessels, robotics, cybernetics, medical technology and health informatics, and artificial intelligence. title: It`s time to build!
description:
Join us in developing the zero-emission energy solutions of the future!

 

We firmly believe that nuclear power will be a major part of the solution for future zero-emission maritime propulsion systems. The team realizing this ambition is being created now. Do you want to be a part of it ?

Senior Mechanical Engineer

About the position:

 

We are looking for you to be part of a growing team of motivated colleagues to develop, test and build our maritime Gen IV nuclear power systems to power future ships. You will contribute to build the first prototype of a complete marine nuclear power system based on our gas-cooled reactor technology. A significant part of the work is preparing, producing, testing and improving the different components in the system, while at the same time building the complete power system test rig and demonstrating this in a moving environment. We are looking for a strong personal interest in the topic and a drive to create safe and sustainable solutions for tomorrow. You will report to the Head of Engineering & Testing – Norway.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Creating, testing and improving reactor system parts and solutions
  • Design and build test environments for different parts.
  • Take part in building the complete nuclear power system with test facilities, and perform the testing required.

  • Collaborate closely with the nuclear engineers in Emerald Nuclear Inc., as well as our partners and suppliers.

     

Qualifications:

 

  • Strong interest in working with complex thermal energy systems and engineering challenges.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience within the topic of mechanical engineering, systems engineering, thermodynamics, and/or material engineering.
  • Master-level education within Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or similar topics. Bachelor level candidates may also apply combined with relevant work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical work experience within materials or mechanical production.
  • Experience with building and handling digital control systems or sensor networks is an advantage.
  • Previous experience with nuclear technology is not required. Necessary training in nuclear applications will be provided.

 

Personal qualities:

 

  • Strong interest in nuclear energy, mechanical engineering, maritime technology and similar topics.
  • Works independently, but comfortable with teamwork.
  • Interested in working with and solving challenges.
  • Structured and methodical.
  • Proactive and positive attitude.

 

Why Emerald Nuclear ?

This is your opportunity to participate in the beginning of a groundbreaking new industry development. With us you are not just working with a new type of technology. You will be part of the development of a completely new energy platform for maritime applications, with the potensial to combine zero-emission technololgy, unprecedented energy density and high reliability.

 

We can offer:

 

  • The opportunity to work with innovative and ground-breaking new technology
  • Be a part of creating completely new prototypes
  • Work in the apex between nuclear technology, mechanics and thermal systems.
  • Competitive salary, pension scheme and insurance package
  • Flexible work hours.
  • Personal development.
  • Free parking.

  • Work location at our engineering and test hub at Stette near the town of Ålesund.

     

We are building the team now:

 

Emerald Nuclear Norway shall lead market development, engineering, testing and the construction of maritime nuclear power systems. We have a very strong ambition to launch a demonstrator in 2031. And we need competent people on this journey. Are you ready to go?

 

Additional positions soon to be announced soon:

 

  • Senior Mechanic
  • Thermal systems engineer
  • Control systems engineer

 

It`s time to build!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Its time to build! Emerald Nuclear Norway AS is a wholly owned subsidiary of Emerald Nuclear Inc., a maritime nuclear energy company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Located in Ålesund, Norway, the company aims to lead market development, engineering, testing, and commerzialisation of maritime nuclear energy systems. Lately there has been a fundamental shift in attitudes toward nuclear energy and its role in the decarbonization of the maritime industry. Nuclear energy has the potential to provide a commercially viable zero-emission alternative to fossil fuels, while delivering the energy efficiency, endurance, and operational reliability required by the maritime market. We place the highest focus on the safety, security and safeguards in order to protect people, ships, communities, and the environment throughout the entire lifecycle of the ship and its nuclear energy system. Our objective is clear: to enable the deployment of the first commercial nuclear-powered offshore demonstration vessel on the Norwegian Continental Shelf by 2031.

title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended with a fourth year for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (including statement of motivation summarizing prior scientific work) + 1-2 pages on research interests and vision for PhD work
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

title: Vil du være med og ta oss til nye høyder? Vi søker avdelingsleder til Møre
description:
Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og virksomhet i 13 land. Felles for oss alle er én viktig oppgave: Å få folk trygt hjem hver dag.

I Norge har vi vokst siden oppstarten i 2009, og i dag består vi av over 500 medarbeidere fordelt på 13 avdelinger. Vi leverer sikkerhetstjenester på vei og byggeplasser, og ambisjonene våre er fortsatt store.

Nå ser vi etter en ny avdelingsleder til Møre.

 

Om rollen

Vi er på jakt etter en avdelingsleder som liker å være i front, som brenner for å finne spennende prosjekter og som trives med å spille andre gode. Vi søker en forretningsorientert avdelingsleder som skal lede, videreutvikle og styrke organisasjonen ved vår avdeling. 

Som avdelingsleder vil du ha ansvar for faglig og administrativ ledelse, organisering, utvikling og drift av avdelingens ressurser og kjerneprosesser.

Som avdelingsleder vil du blant annet:

  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere og arbeidsmiljøet i avdelingen
  • Videreutvikle relasjoner med eksisterende kunder og skape nye muligheter i markedet
  • Sørge for at sikkerhet alltid ligger i fundamentet for alt vi gjør
  • Sikre god drift, kvalitet og lønnsomhet i prosjekter og leveranser

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du trives i møte med kunder og har gjerne erfaring fra bygg - og anleggsbransjen og/eller skiltmyndigheter. Du trives også med nybrottsarbeid og motiveres av å skape vekst. Videre ser vi etter en løsningsorientert person som arbeider strukturert og målrettet, som er en god serviceleder og som har evnen til å inspirere og motivere sine ansatte i en organisasjon som må være fleksibel og handlekraftig for å tilfredsstille kundesegmentet. I vår organisasjon verdsetter vi lokalkunnskap, kompetanse, fleksibilitet, initiativ og handlekraft.

Du er en pålitelig og troverdig person som evner å skape tillit til de rundt deg, lære på eget initiativ, sette deg klare mål og jobbe systematisk mot dem. For oss er det viktig at du er en lagspiller som ikke lar deg vippe av pinnen verken av motgang eller suksess. Da tror vi at vi kan få til utrolig mye bra sammen.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant utdanning, fortrinnsvis innen tekniske fag eller ledelse.

  • Prosjekterfaring

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig.

Hva vi kan tilby

  • Muligheten til å utvikle en viktig avdeling i et selskap med sterke vekstambisjoner
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo og stor takhøyde
  • Dyktige kolleger som deler kunnskap og heier på hverandre
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi tilbyr deg en selvstendig lederrolle hos en offensiv og solid arbeidsgiver. Du får være tett på driften, ha stor påvirkningskraft og jobbe med løsninger som er etterspurt i markedet.

 

Interessert?

Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg. Send oss din søknad og CV.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Head of Operations Pål Hartvik Johannessen i Ramudden Norge AS på telefon 982 86 367. Alle henvendelser vil bli behandlet konfidensielt.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

title: Tilkallingsvikarer Bjøråsen skole
description:
Bjøråsen er en 8.–10. skole som ligger flott til øverst på Romsås i bydel Grorud. Skolen har tilrettelagte uteområder rundt skolen og kort vei til Lillomarka hvor deler av undervisningen finner sted. Skolen har ca. 197 fantastiske elever (august 2026) fordelt på 8. til 10. trinn pluss en mottaksklasse. Personalet teller omtrent 38 ansatte.

Vi på Bjøråsen skole er opptatte av at skolen skal være et sted der det utdannes demokratiske mennesker som både vil og kan ta ansvar for seg selv og andre. Vi vet at samarbeid fremmer læring. Derfor står samarbeid i høy kurs på alle skolens arenaer. Vi har høye ambisjoner på vegne av både oss selv og elevene! Vi ønsker å videreutvikle oss innenfor kvalitet i undervisningen og tilpasset opplæring. Bjøråsen skole skal være en læringsfremmende skole der elever og skolens ansatte spiller på lag og bidrar til et optimalt læringsmiljø. Vi håper du har lyst til å være med oss på dette oppdraget!
 
Vi søker tilkallingsvikarer som kan ta korte og lengre oppdrag. Stillingsprosenten vil variere ut fra behovet til skolen. Vi søker vikarer som er tilgjengelige for oppdrag umiddelbart.

Lærerstudenter og studenter innen spesialpedagogikk oppfordres spesielt til å søke. Dette kan være en spennende mulighet til å få verdifull erfaring fra skoleverket og bidra til elevenes læring og utvikling.

title: People & Culture Manager til Fýri Resort, Hemsedal
description:
Vil du være med å forme fremtidens arbeidsplass på et av Norges mest unike resorter?

Fýri Resort søker nå en engasjert og forretningsorientert People & Culture Manager som ønsker å kombinere operativt HR-arbeid med strategisk påvirkning. Dette er en sentral rolle i organisasjonen, hvor du blir en del av ledergruppen og får muligheten til å bidra aktivt til utviklingen av både mennesker, kultur og virksomhet.

Om rollen

Som People & Culture Manager vil du ha det overordnede ansvaret for HR- og kulturarbeidet ved Fýri Resort. Du vil være en viktig støttespiller for våre ledere og medarbeidere, og jobbe bredt innen alt fra arbeidsrett og medarbeideroppfølging til lederutvikling, organisasjonsutvikling og kulturbygging.

En stor del av rollen handler om å støtte, veilede og coache våre avdelingsledere i deres arbeid som ledere. Du vil være en rådgiver og sparringspartner i både operative og strategiske spørsmål, og bidra til å utvikle en sterk lederkultur på tvers av organisasjonen.

Du vil jobbe tett på driften i en virksomhet som preges av høyt tempo, sesongvariasjoner og et internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø. Rollen krever at du er synlig i organisasjonen, bygger sterke relasjoner og trives med å veksle mellom strategiske diskusjoner i ledergruppen og praktisk støtte ute i driften.

Du vil ha det overordnede HR-ansvaret på Fýri Resort og være en del av ESS Groups People & Culture-nettverk, hvor du får tilgang til faglig sparring, kompetanse og støtte fra kolleger på tvers av konsernet.

Fýri Resort har medarbeidere fra hele verden og en drift som varierer gjennom sesongene. Dette gjør rollen både kompleks, spennende og avgjørende for å sikre gode medarbeideropplevelser gjennom hele året.

Ansvarsområder

  • Rådgivning og støtte til ledere i personal- og arbeidsrettslige spørsmål

  • Sikre etterlevelse av norsk arbeidsrett og interne retningslinjer

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og medarbeiderutvikling

  • Lederstøtte, coaching og kompetanseutvikling

  • Bidra til organisasjonsutvikling og forbedringsarbeid

  • Drive og videreutvikle Fýris kulturarbeid

  • Delta aktivt i ledergruppen og bidra med strategiske perspektiver

  • Samarbeide tett med ledere for å sikre gode medarbeideropplevelser gjennom hele medarbeiderreisen

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har erfaring fra HR-arbeid på operativt og strategisk nivå

  • Har solid kompetanse innen norsk arbeidsrett

  • Trives med å veilede, utfordre og utvikle ledere

  • Er trygg i rådgiverrollen og bygger tillit på tvers av organisasjonen

  • Har god forretningsforståelse og et helhetlig perspektiv på HR

  • Gjerne har ledererfaring

  • Erfaring med lønnsadministrasjon er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Behersker et skandinavisk språk flytende, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Har svært gode engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

Språk og kommunikasjon

Fýri er en internasjonal arbeidsplass med ledere og medarbeidere fra mange ulike land. Derfor er det viktig at du kan kommunisere trygt og profesjonelt på både et skandinavisk språk og engelsk.

Du må være komfortabel med å gjennomføre medarbeidersamtaler, lederstøtte, oppfølging og arbeidsrettslige prosesser på begge språk. Flere av våre ledere har engelsk som arbeidsspråk, og rollen krever derfor at du kan formidle komplekse HR- og arbeidsrettslige problemstillinger på en tydelig og trygg måte, både på engelsk og et skandinavisk språk.

Derfor vil du trives hos oss

Hos Fýri tror vi at gode resultater skapes gjennom sterke relasjoner, tydelig lederskap og en kultur der mennesker trives og utvikler seg. Kulturarbeid er ikke et sideprosjekt hos oss. Det er en viktig del av hvordan vi jobber hver dag.

Du vil få en sentral rolle i et dynamisk miljø med høyt tempo, stor påvirkningskraft og muligheten til å være med på å videreutvikle både organisasjonen og medarbeideropplevelsen.

Som en del av ESS Group får du attraktive medarbeiderfordeler, blant annet gode priser på hotellopphold og restaurantbesøk på våre destinasjoner, friskvårdsbidrag og muligheten til å delta i ESS Academy sine lederutviklingsprogrammer og andre spennende utviklingsinitiativer.

Arbeidssted

Stillingen er 100 % stedbasert ved Fýri Resort i Hemsedal. Vi ønsker en People & Culture Manager som er tett på både drift, ledere og medarbeidere i hverdagen.

Søknad

Tiltredelse ønskes så snart som mulig. Vi gjennomfører intervjuer fortløpende og anbefaler derfor interesserte kandidater å sende inn søknad snarest.

Ønsker du å være med på å skape Norges beste arbeidsplass i reiselivsbransjen? Da håper vi å høre fra deg. 🚀

title: Helsefagarbeidar - 100% fast
description:
Vil du ha ein jobb der du gjer ein forskjell kvar dag, utviklar deg fagleg og der me har fokus på eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø?

Vinje sjukeheim søkjer ein engasjert helsefagarbeidar i 100 % fast stilling. Hos oss får du ein variert og meiningsfull arbeidskvardag der du er med på å skape tryggleik, meistring og gode opplevingar for bebuarane våre.

Ved Vinje sjukeheim er me opptekne av å sjå den enkelte bebuar. Me legg vekt på livskvalitet og gode relasjonar. Kvar dag jobbar me for å skape ein trygg og meiningsfull kvardag for bebuarane gjennom omsorg, fagleg kvalitet og aktivitetar som gir glede og meistring. Som medarbeidar hos oss blir du ein del av eit inkluderande fagmiljø der dine idear og meiningar blir hørt.

Du får god opplæring, støtte frå erfarne kollegaer og moglegheit til å utvikle kompetansen din innan eldreomsorg og demensomsorg. Me nyttar årsturnus, noko som gir deg stor grad av fleksibilitet og innverknad på eigen arbeidskvardag. Saman skaper me ikkje berre gode dagar for bebuarane våre, men også ein arbeidsplass der folk trivst, utviklar seg og blir verande.

Langtidsavdelinga har 25 rom fordelt på tre grupper. To av gruppene er tilpassa personar med demens, og ei gruppe er ei somatisk langtidsavdeling.

  • Er fleksibel og løysingsorientert i ein variert arbeidskvardag
  • Bidreg til eit positivt, inkluderande og utviklingsretta arbeidsmiljø
  • Er fagleg engasjert og ønskjer å bidra til kvalitet og utvikling i tenestene
  • Har evne til å skape tillit og gode relasjonar

Me legg vekt på personlege eigenskapar ved tilsetjing.

Vi tilbyr

  • Aktivitetskortordning med gåvekort, og mogelegheit for å vinne flotte premiar
  • Ein arbeidsplass i naturskjønne omgjevnader med gode moglegheiter for friluftsliv året rundt
  • Ei meiningsfull og variert stilling i eit godt fagmiljø
  • Eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer

I samsvar med offentleglova § 25 kan namn på søkjarane offentleggjerast. 

For stillingar der det er krav om politiattest, må godkjend attest leggast fram før tilsetting.

Vinje kommune er oppteken av mangfald, og ynskjer at tilsette i kommunen reflekterer mangfaldet i lokalsamfunnet. Me oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn.

description:

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er pålitelig, serviceinnstilt og opptatt av å levere godt renhold.

Det viktigste for oss er at du:

  • møter til avtalt tid og holder det du lover

  • arbeider grundig og har øye for detaljer

  • tar ansvar for eget arbeid

  • følger rutiner og sier fra dersom noe er uklart

  • opptrer profesjonelt overfor kunder

Erfaring fra renhold er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi gir opplæring og legger stor vekt på riktig innstilling, pålitelighet og vilje til å lære.

Arbeidsområdet er hovedsakelig Otta, Høvringen, Lemonsjøen og andre steder innen omtrent 50 km fra Otta.

Arbeidsmengden varierer etter kundenes behov. Vi har særlig behov for ekstra kapasitet i vinter- og sommersesongen, og enkelte oppdrag kan komme på relativt kort varsel.

Vi forventer ikke at du alltid skal være tilgjengelig. Når vi har behov for hjelp, tar vi kontakt og spør om du har mulighet til å ta oppdraget.

Vi ønsker å bygge et stabilt team der godt arbeid, pålitelighet og ansvar blir lagt merke til.

  • direkte og enkel kommunikasjon

  • mulighet for mer regelmessig arbeid dersom samarbeidet fungerer godt og behovet øker

Laidoner Renhold er et lokalt renholdsfirma med base i Otta. Vi tilbyr renholdstjenester til private og bedrifter i Otta og nærliggende områder, blant annet Høvringen og Lemonsjøen.

Vi legger stor vekt på kvalitet, pålitelighet og god service. Målet vårt er å levere grundig renhold med høy standard og samtidig bygge gode, langsiktige relasjoner med både kunder og medarbeidere.

Det vil etter behov påløpe dagsreiser eller kortere opphold på en av selskapets lokasjoner. En mer detaljert beskrivelse presiseres i videre arbeidsavtale.

Vi tilbyr

  • Gode lønnsbetingelser

  • Fleksibilitet i arbeidstider og ferieperioder

  • Å bli en del av et energisk arbeidsmiljø!

  • Muligheten til å være med å utvikle Norges største treningssenterkjede

  • Oppfølging og tilgang til et sterkt team

Du vil være sentral i den daglige driften av Feel24 i Vesterålen med mulighet for å lære mye og utvikle deg innen treningssenterbransjen.

Utgangspunkt for arbeid: Sortland

Arbeidssted: Sortland, Stokmarknes, Melbu, Myre og Andenes

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Feel24 er Norges største treningssenterkjede. Vi har skapt et treningskonsept basert på medlemmenes ønsker og vilkår! Vi har over 100 senter i Norge.

Feel24 passer for alle uansett alder, fasong eller bakgrunn. Vi har et lavterskel treningskonsept, som sørger for at man skal føle deg trygg og komfortabel når man trener hos oss. Vi har en fast lav pris for alle våre medlemmer og døgnåpne senter. Uansett hvilket senter man er medlem på, har man tilgang på alle våre avdelinger i hele kjeden.

Sentrene våre er delt inn i ulike soner, og med god kapasitet, slik at treningen skal være mest mulig behagelig. Vi har lyse flotte lokaler, nytt og variert treningsutstyr, og lav bakgrunnsmusikk for en behagelig treningsøkt. Aldersgrensen på sentrene våre er 15 år.

title: Helsefagarbeider/tekniker/sykepleierstudent
description:
Anestesiavdelingen er organisert under Kirurgisk divisjon og består av anestesi-, intensiv- og  postoperativ seksjon, anestesilegene og smertepoliklinikken. Avdelingen har 290 årsverk fordelt på sykepleiere, leger, hjelpepleiere, sekretærer og teknikere.

Postoperativ har 67 årsverk for intensivsykepleiere, sykepleiere, hjelpepleiere/ helsefagarbeider/ tekniker og sekretær. Seksjonen har fagansvarlig anestesioverlege.

Seksjonen har ledig 25% fast stilling med arbeid hver 3.helg. Vi søker hjelpepleiere/ helsefagarbeider/ tekniker/sykepleierstudent som fortrinnsvis har erfaring fra sykehus.  

Trives du med:

  • Faglige utfordringer og varierte arbeidsoppgaver?
  • Å arbeide i tverrfaglige team?
  • Utviklingsmuligheter, ved å arbeide i en seksjon som har fokus på fag-, kompetanse og kvalitetsutvikling

Da er det deg vi søker, velkommen på laget!


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Daglig forefallende arbeid med ajourføring av lager, noe bestilling av varer/varemottak, skylleroms arbeid, rydde og holde orden på pasientrom, rengjøring/ klargjøring av medisinsk-teknisk utstyr
  • Utføre seksjonens kontrollrutiner
  • Bistå sykepleier på postoperativ i stell og mobilisering av postoperative pasienter, samt møte pårørende
  • Du vil ikke ha direkte pasientansvar
  • Du inngår i team med 2 hjelpepleiere/ helsefagarbeidere/ tekniker, forsyningsportør og vil også ha tett samarbeid med sykepleiekoordinator og seksjonsledelsen
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har gyldig norsk autorisasjon som helsesefagarbeider, har relevant erfaring som tekniker eller som sykepleierstudent
  • Har gode språkferdigheter muntlig og skriftlig på norsk
  • Relevant klinisk erfaring
  • Har gode datakunnskaper
  • Løsningsorientert, fremoverlent og trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø
  • Jobber effektivt og strukturert

I tillegg mener vi det er en fordel om du:

  • Har erfaring fra sykehus.
Personlige egenskaper

For at du skal lykkes i jobben tror vi at:

  • Du har en utpreget serviceinnstilling med høyt engasjement og en positiv tilnærming 
  • Du er opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet som utføres og jobber nøyaktig og strukturert
  • Du må samarbeide godt, ta ansvar, se muligheter og være villig til endringer som foretas
  • Du må trives i til tider hektiske perioder og ha en høy arbeidskapasitet 

Personlighet egnethet vektlegges 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt ved Ahus vil du spille en nøkkelrolle i å løse vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag!

Hos oss setter vi stor pris på både din trivsel og ditt engasjement – både på jobb og i fritiden. Hos oss får du tilgang til et rikt og variert kultur- og fritidstilbud som gir deg muligheten til å koble av, ha det gøy og bygge fellesskap på tvers av avdelinger.

Vårt bedriftsidrettslag byr på et bredt spekter av innendørs og utendørs aktiviteter som fremmer trivsel og samhold. I tillegg kan du delta i kor, revygruppe, eller benytte deg av våre ferieleiligheter, hytter og en rekke andre spennende kulturtilbud, rabatter og fordeler.

Ahus har også flere personalbarnehager og alle som har et ansettelsesforhold ved foretaket kan søke plass, uavhengig av hvilken kommune de bor i. Barnehagene ligger i umiddelbar nærhet til vår lokasjon på Nordbyhagen. 

Som ansatt kan du leie bolig av Ahus på Nordbyhagen.Boligene varierer i størrelse fra 1-roms til 4- roms leiligheter i blokker, rekkehus og småhus. 

Les mer om alle våre tilbud for våre ansatte her: www.ahus.no/om-oss/ansatte

title: Er du under utdanning og ønsker å få relevant jobberfaring? Eller har du mulighet til å jobbe som vikar?
description:
Stjørdal barne- og avlastning søker etter vikarer som kan kontaktes ved korttids- og langtidsfravær. 

Barne- og avlastningstjenesten gir tilbud til familier som på grunn av barns funksjonsnedsettelser trenger avlastning i den daglige omsorgen. Tjenesten yter bistand innenfor veiledning, koordinering, fritidstilbud og avlastning for barn og familier. Tjenesten er individuelt tilpasset og arbeidsoppgavene vil variere etter hvem som til en hver tid har behov for avlastning og samarbeid.

Her kan du lese mer om oss: Barne- og avlastningstjenesten - Stjørdal kommune. Ta gjerne kontakt hvis du har spørsmål eller er nysgjerrig på hva dette innebærer.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgaver omfatter miljøarbeid, praktisk bistand, omsorg og tilrettelegging for barn som er på avlastning. Du vil delta i daglige aktiviteter, støtte barna i deres utvikling og mestring, samt samarbeide tett med foresatte og fagpersoner.

Personlige egenskaper:

Det viktigste for oss er at du har et godt lag med barn, liker å være aktiv og er en stødig voksenperson. I tillegg setter vi stor pris på at du som vikar er fleksibel, samarbeidsvillig og kan stille opp ved behov.

  • Meningsfylte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Lønns- og arbeidsvilkår etter gjeldende regelverk
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Andre opplysninger:

For denne stillingen vil det i henhold til gjeldende lovverk kreves fremlagt tilfredsstillende politiattest før tiltredelse. I samsvar med offentlighetsloven § 25 gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkere kan offentliggjøres, selv om det er bedt om konfidensiell behandling. Søkere vil i tilfelle bli forhåndsvarslet om dette.

Stjørdal kommune ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn eller minoritetsbakgrunn.

Stjørdal er en voksende bykommune som farges av et rikt idretts- og kulturliv, gode naturopplevelser og møteplasser som innbyr til fellesskap og mangfold. I Stjørdal er det godt å vokse opp og bo.
